verses.sa:
अग्ने जायस्वादितिर्नाथितेयं ब्रह्मौदनं पचति पुत्रकामा ।
सप्तऋषयो भूतकृतस्ते त्वा मन्थन्तु प्रजया सहेह ॥
verses.rom:
agne jayasvaditirnathiteyam brahmaudanam pachati putrakama |
saptarishayo bhutakritaste tva manthantu prajaya saheha ||
verses.en: O Agni, be thou born; Aditi here, suppliant, cooks a brahmán-rice-dish, desiring sons; the seven seers, being-makers—let them churn thee here together with progeny.

verses.sa:
कृणुत धूमं वृषणः सखायोऽद्रोघाविता वाचमच्छ ।
अयमग्निः पृतनाषाट्सुवीरो येन देवा असहन्त दस्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
krinuta dhumam vrishanah sakhayo'droghavita vachamachchha |
ayamagnih pritanashatsuviro yena deva asahanta dasyun ||
verses.en: Make ye smoke, O ye bulls, companions, ye that are aided by the unhateful (?), unto speech; this Agni [is] fight-overpowering, having good heroes, by whom the gods overpowered the barbarians.

verses.sa:
अग्नेऽजनिष्ठा महते वीर्याय ब्रह्मौदनाय पक्तवे जातवेदः ।
सप्तऋषयो भूतकृतस्ते त्वाजीजनन्न् अस्यै रयिं सर्ववीरं नि यच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
agne'janishtha mahate viryaya brahmaudanaya paktave jatavedah |
saptarishayo bhutakritaste tvajijanann asyai rayim sarvaviram ni yachchha ||
verses.en: O Agni, thou hast been born unto great heroism, unto the cooking of the brahmán-rice-dish, O Jātavedas; the seven seers, have given thee birth; do thou confirm to this woman wealth with all heroes.

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अग्ने समिधा समिध्यस्व विद्वान् देवान् यज्ञियामेह वक्षः ।
तेभ्यो हविः श्रपयं जातवेद उत्तमं नाकमधि रोहयेमम् ॥
verses.rom:
samiddho agne samidha samidhyasva vidvan devan yajniyameha vakshah |
tebhyo havih shrapayam jataveda uttamam nakamadhi rohayemam ||
verses.en: Kindled, O Agni, be thou kindled with kindling (samídh); mayest thou bring hither, knowing, the worshipful gods; for them cooking (çrā) the oblation, O Jātavedas, make thou this man to ascend to the highest firmament (nā́ka).

verses.sa:
त्रेधा भागो निहितो यः पुरा वो देवानां पितॄणां मर्त्यानाम् ।
अंशां जानीध्वं वि भजामि तान् वो यो देवानां स इमां पारयाति ॥
verses.rom:
tredha bhago nihito yah pura vo devanam pitrinam martyanam |
amsham janidhvam vi bhajami tan vo yo devanam sa imam parayati ||
verses.en: Threefold is set down the share that is yours of old—of gods, of Fathers, of mortals; know ye the portions (áṅça); I share them out to you; that one that is the gods' shall set this woman across.

verses.sa:
अग्ने सहस्वान् अभिभूरभीदसि नीचो न्युब्ज द्विषतः सपत्नान् ।
इयं मात्रा मीयमाना मिता च सजातांस्ते बलिहृतः कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
agne sahasvan abhibhurabhidasi nicho nyubja dvishatah sapatnan |
iyam matra miyamana mita cha sajatamste balihritah krinotu ||
verses.en: O Agni, powerful, overcoming, thou overcomest; put down (ni-ubj) [our] hating rivals; let this measure (mā́trā), being measured, and measured, make [thy] fellows tribute-bringers to thee.

verses.sa:
साकं सजातैः पयसा सहैध्युदुब्जैनां महते वीर्याय ।
ऊर्ध्वो नाकस्याधि रोह विष्टपं स्वर्गो लोक इति यं वदन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
sakam sajataih payasa sahaidhyudubjainam mahate viryaya |
urdhvo nakasyadhi roha vishtapam svargo loka iti yam vadanti ||
verses.en: In company with thy fellows, be thou united with milk; urge her up unto great heroism; ascend aloft to the summit (viṣṭáp) of the firmament (nā́ka), which they call by the name heavenly world.

verses.sa:
इयं मही प्रति गृह्णातु चर्म पृथिवी देवी सुमनस्यमाना ।
अथ गच्छेम सुकृतस्य लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
iyam mahi prati grihnatu charma prithivi devi sumanasyamana |
atha gachchhema sukritasya lokam ||
verses.en: Let this great one (mahī́) accept the hide, the divine earth, with favoring mind; then may we go to the world of the well-done.

verses.sa:
एतौ ग्रावाणौ सयुजा युङ्धि चर्मणि निर्बिन्ध्यंशून् यजमानाय साधु ।
अवघ्नती नि जहि य इमां पृतन्यव ऊर्ध्वं प्रजामुद्भरन्त्युदूह ॥
verses.rom:
etau gravanau sayuja yundhi charmani nirbindhyamshun yajamanaya sadhu |
avaghnati ni jahi ya imam pritanyava urdhvam prajamudbharantyuduha ||
verses.en: Join thou on the hide these two allied stones; split apart the shoots (aṅçú) successfully for the sacrificer; smiting down, smite them that would fight her; bearing up thy progeny aloft, lift up.

verses.sa:
गृहाण ग्रावाणौ सकृतौ वीर हस्त आ ते देवा यज्ञिया यज्ञमगुः ।
त्रयो वरा यतमांस्त्वं वृणीषे तास्ते समृद्धीरिह राधयामि ॥
verses.rom:
grihana gravanau sakritau vira hasta a te deva yajniya yajnamaguh |
trayo vara yatamamstvam vrinishe taste samriddhiriha radhayami ||
verses.en: Seize in thy hand, O hero, the two joint-acting (sakṛ́t) stones; the worshipful gods have come to thy sacrifice; three boons, whichsoever thou choosest—those successes do I here make successful for thee.

verses.sa:
इयं ते धीतिरिदमु ते जनित्रं गृह्णातु त्वामदितिः शूरपुत्रा ।
परा पुनीहि य इमां पृतन्यवोऽस्यै रयिं सर्ववीरं नि यच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
iyam te dhitiridamu te janitram grihnatu tvamaditih shuraputra |
para punihi ya imam pritanyavo'syai rayim sarvaviram ni yachchha ||
verses.en: This [is] thy thought (? dhītí) and this thy place of birth; let Aditi, of hero-sons, seize thee; cleanse away them that would fight her; confirm to her wealth with all heroes.

verses.sa:
उपश्वसे द्रुवये सीदता यूयं वि विच्यध्वं यज्ञियासस्तुषैः ।
श्रिया समानान् अति सर्वान्त्स्यामाधस्पदं द्विषतस्पादयामि ॥
verses.rom:
upashvase druvaye sidata yuyam vi vichyadhvam yajniyasastushaih |
shriya samanan ati sarvantsyamadhaspadam dvishataspadayami ||
verses.en: Sit ye in the wooden blower (? upaçvasá); be ye winnowed, worshipful ones, from the husks. By fortune (çrī́) may we surpass all [our] equals; I make [our] haters to fall under foot.

verses.sa:
परेहि नारि पुनरेहि क्षिप्रमपां त्वा गोष्ठो अध्यरुक्षद्भराय ।
तासां गृह्णीताद्यतमा यज्ञिया असन् विभाज्य धीरीतरा जहीतात् ॥
verses.rom:
parehi nari punarehi kshipramapam tva goshtho adhyarukshadbharaya |
tasam grihnitadyatama yajniya asan vibhajya dhiritara jahitat ||
verses.en: Go away, woman; come back quickly; the stall (goṣṭhá) of the waters hath ascended thee for bearing; seize then of them f. whichever shall be worshipful; having shared [them] out wisely, then leave the others.

verses.sa:
एमा अगुर्योषितः शुम्भमाना उत्तिष्ठ नारि तवसं रभस्व ।
सुपत्नी पत्या प्रजया प्रजावत्या त्वागन् यज्ञः प्रति कुम्भं गृभाय ॥
verses.rom:
ema aguryoshitah shumbhamana uttishtha nari tavasam rabhasva |
supatni patya prajaya prajavatya tvagan yajnah prati kumbham gribhaya ||
verses.en: These maidens (yoṣít) have come, adorning themselves; stand up, woman, take hold of the mighty one; well-spoused with husband, progeny-possessing with progeny; to thee hath come the sacrifice; receive thou the vessel (kumbhá).

verses.sa:
ऊर्जो भागो निहितो यः पुरा व ऋषिप्रशिष्टाप आ भरैताः ।
अयं यज्ञो गातुविन् नाथवित्प्रजाविदुग्रः पशुविद्वीरविद्वो अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
urjo bhago nihito yah pura va rishiprashishtapa a bharaitah |
ayam yajno gatuvin nathavitprajavidugrah pashuvidviravidvo astu ||
verses.en: The portion of refreshment (ū́rj) [is] set down which [is] yours of old; do thou, instructed by the seer, bring these waters; let this sacrifice be for you progress-gaining (gātu-víd), refuge-gaining, progeny-gaining, formidable, cattle-gaining, hero-gaining.

verses.sa:
अग्ने चरुर्यज्ञियस्त्वाध्यरुक्षच्छुचिस्तपिष्ठस्तपसा तपैनम् ।
आर्षेया दैवा अभिसंगत्य भागमिमं तपिष्ठा ऋतुभिस्तपन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
agne charuryajniyastvadhyarukshachchhuchistapishthastapasa tapainam |
arsheya daiva abhisamgatya bhagamimam tapishtha ritubhistapantu ||
verses.en: O Agni, the worshipful pot hath ascended thee; bright (çúci), very hot, do thou heat it with heat; let those of the seers, those of the gods, gathering unto their share, very hot, heat this with the seasons.

verses.sa:
शुद्धाः पूता योषितो यज्ञिया इमा आपश्चरुमव सर्पन्तु शुभ्राः ।
अदुः प्रजां बहुलां पशून् नः पक्तौदनस्य सुकृतामेतु लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
shuddhah puta yoshito yajniya ima apashcharumava sarpantu shubhrah |
aduh prajam bahulam pashun nah paktaudanasya sukritametu lokam ||
verses.en: Let these cleansed, purified, worshipful maidens, the waters, beauteous ones, creep down to the pot; they have given us abundant progeny, cattle; let the cooker of the rice-dish go to the world of the well-doers.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणा शुद्धा उत पूता घृतेन सोमस्यांशवस्तण्डुला यज्ञिया इमे ।
अपः प्र विशत प्रति गृह्णातु वश्चरुरिमं पक्त्वा सुकृतामेत लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
brahmana shuddha uta puta ghritena somasyamshavastandula yajniya ime |
apah pra vishata prati grihnatu vashcharurimam paktva sukritameta lokam ||
verses.en: Cleansed with prayer (bráhman) and purified with ghee, shoots of Soma [are] these worshipful rice-grains; enter ye the waters; let the pot receive you; having cooked this, go ye to the world of the well-doers.

verses.sa:
उरुः प्रथस्व महता महिम्ना सहस्रपृष्ठः सुकृतस्य लोके ।
पितामहाः पितरः प्रजोपजाहं पक्ता पञ्चदशस्ते अस्मि ॥
verses.rom:
uruh prathasva mahata mahimna sahasraprishthah sukritasya loke |
pitamahah pitarah prajopajaham pakta panchadashaste asmi ||
verses.en: Spread thyself broad, with great greatness, thousand-backed, in the world of the well-done: grandfathers, fathers, progeny, descendants (upajā́): I am thy fifteen-fold cooker.

verses.sa:
सहस्रपृष्ठः शतधारो अक्षितो ब्रह्मौदनो देवयानः स्वर्गः ।
अमूंस्त आ दधामि प्रजया रेषयैनान् बलिहाराय मृडतान् मह्यमेव ॥
verses.rom:
sahasraprishthah shatadharo akshito brahmaudano devayanah svargah |
amumsta a dadhami prajaya reshayainan baliharaya mridatan mahyameva ||
verses.en: Thousand-backed, hundred-streamed, unexhausted, [is] the brahmán-rice-dish, god-traveled, heaven-going; them yonder I assign to thee; lessen (?) thou them with progeny; be gracious then to me [as] bringer of tribute.

verses.sa:
उदेहि वेदिं प्रजया वर्धयैनां नुदस्व रक्षः प्रतरं धेह्येनाम् ।
श्रिया समानान् अति सर्वान्त्स्यामाधस्पदं द्विषतस्पादयामि ॥
verses.rom:
udehi vedim prajaya vardhayainam nudasva rakshah prataram dhehyenam |
shriya samanan ati sarvantsyamadhaspadam dvishataspadayami ||
verses.en: Go thou up to the sacrificial hearth; increase her with progeny; push [away] the demon; set her further forward; by fortune may we surpass all [our] equals; I make [our] haters to fall under foot.

verses.sa:
अभ्यावर्तस्व पशुभिः सहैनां प्रत्यङ्ङेनां देवताभिः सहैधि ।
मा त्वा प्रापच्छपथो माभिचारः स्वे क्षेत्रे अनमीवा वि राज ॥
verses.rom:
abhyavartasva pashubhih sahainam pratyannenam devatabhih sahaidhi |
ma tva prapachchhapatho mabhicharah sve kshetre anamiva vi raja ||
verses.en: Turn thou toward her together with cattle; be opposite to her together with the divinities; let not curse attain thee, nor witchcraft (abhicārá); bear rule (vi-rāj) in thine own field (kṣétra), free from disease.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन तष्टा मनसा हितैषा ब्रह्मौदनस्य विहिता वेदिरग्रे ।
अंसद्रीं शुद्धामुप धेहि नारि तत्रौदनं सादय दैवानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ritena tashta manasa hitaisha brahmaudanasya vihita vediragre |
amsadrim shuddhamupa dhehi nari tatraudanam sadaya daivanam ||
verses.en: Fashioned by righteousness (ṛtá), set by mind, this was ordained in the beginning the sacrificial hearth of the brahmán-rice-dish; apply, O woman, the cleansed shoulder-bearer (?); on that set the rice-dish of them of the gods.

verses.sa:
अदितेर्हस्तां स्रुचमेतां द्वितीयां सप्तऋषयो भूतकृतो यामकृण्वन् ।
सा गात्राणि विदुष्योदनस्य दर्विर्वेद्यामध्येनं चिनोतु ॥
verses.rom:
aditerhastam sruchametam dvitiyam saptarishayo bhutakrito yamakrinvan |
sa gatrani vidushyodanasya darvirvedyamadhyenam chinotu ||
verses.en: Aditi's hand, this second ladle (srúc), which the seven seers, being-makers, made—let that spoon, knowing the members of the rice-dish, collect it upon the sacrificial hearth.

verses.sa:
शृतं त्वा हव्यमुप सीदन्तु दैवा निःसृप्याग्नेः पुनरेनान् प्र सीद ।
सोमेन पूतो जठरे सीद ब्रह्मणामार्षेयास्ते मा रिषन् प्राशितारः ॥
verses.rom:
shritam tva havyamupa sidantu daiva nihsripyagneh punarenan pra sida |
somena puto jathare sida brahmanamarsheyaste ma rishan prashitarah ||
verses.en: Let them of the gods sit by thee, a cooked (çṛtá) oblation; having crept out of the fire, sit thou forward again to them; purified by soma, sit thou in the belly of the worshipers (brahmán); let not them of the seers, partakers (prāçitṛ́) of thee, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
सोम राजन्त्संज्ञानमा वपैभ्यः सुब्राह्मणा यतमे त्वोपसीदान् ।
ऋषीन् आर्षेयांस्तपसोऽधि जातान् ब्रह्मौदने सुहवा जोहवीमि ॥
verses.rom:
soma rajantsamjnanama vapaibhyah subrahmana yatame tvopasidan |
rishin arsheyamstapaso'dhi jatan brahmaudane suhava johavimi ||
verses.en: O king Soma, strew harmony for them, for whatsoever good Brahmans shall sit by thee; with good call, I call loudly to the brahmán-rice-dish the seers, them of the seers, born from penance (tápas).

verses.sa:
शुद्धाः पूता योषितो यज्ञिया इमा ब्रह्मणां हस्तेषु प्रपृथक्सादयामि ।
यत्काम इदमभिषिञ्चामि वोऽहमिन्द्रो मरुत्वान्त्स ददादिदं मे ॥
verses.rom:
shuddhah puta yoshito yajniya ima brahmanam hasteshu praprithaksadayami |
yatkama idamabhishinchami vo'hamindro marutvantsa dadadidam me ||
verses.en: These cleansed purified worshipful maidens I seat in separate succession in the hands of the priests (brahmán); with what desire I now pour you on, may Indra here with the Maruts grant me that.

verses.sa:
इदं मे ज्योतिरमृतं हिरण्यं पक्वं क्षेत्रात्कामदुघा म एषा ।
इदं धनं नि दधे ब्राह्मणेषु कृण्वे पन्थां पितृषु यः स्वर्गः ॥
verses.rom:
idam me jyotiramritam hiranyam pakvam kshetratkamadugha ma esha |
idam dhanam ni dadhe brahmaneshu krinve pantham pitrishu yah svargah ||
verses.en: This my light (jyótis), immortal gold, cooked (pakvá) from the field, this my desire-milker; this riches I deposit in the Brahmans; I make a road to the Fathers that is heaven-going.

verses.sa:
अग्नौ तुषान् आ वप जातवेदसि परः कम्बूकामप मृड्ढि दूरम् ।
एतं शुश्रुम गृहराजस्य भागमथो विद्म निर्ऋतेर्भागधेयम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnau tushan a vapa jatavedasi parah kambukamapa mriddhi duram |
etam shushruma griharajasya bhagamatho vidma nirriterbhagadheyam ||
verses.en: Strew thou the husks in the fire, in Jātavedas; wipe off far away the chaff (? kambū́kān); this we have heard to be the share of the house-king; also we know the portion (bhāgadhéya) of Perdition (nírṛti).

verses.sa:
श्राम्यतः पचतो विद्धि सुन्वतः पन्थां स्वर्गमधि रोहयैनम् ।
येन रोहात्परमापद्य यद्वय उत्तमं नाकं परमं व्योम ॥
verses.rom:
shramyatah pachato viddhi sunvatah pantham svargamadhi rohayainam |
yena rohatparamapadya yadvaya uttamam nakam paramam vyoma ||
verses.en: Know thou the toiling, cooking, soma-pressing one; make him to ascend the heaven-going road, by which he may ascend, arriving at the vigor that is beyond, to the highest firmament, to the furthest vault (vyòmati).

verses.sa:
बभ्रेरध्वर्यो मुखमेतद्वि मृड्ढ्याज्याय लोकं कृणुहि प्रविद्वान् ।
घृतेन गात्रानु सर्वा वि मृड्ढि कृण्वे पन्थां पितृषु यः स्वर्गः ॥
verses.rom:
babhreradhvaryo mukhametadvi mriddhyajyaya lokam krinuhi pravidvan |
ghritena gatranu sarva vi mriddhi krinve pantham pitrishu yah svargah ||
verses.en: Wipe off, O serving priest (adhvaryú), this face of the bearing one (? babhrí); make thou, understanding it, room for the sacrificial butter; wipe off with ghee along all [its] members; I make a road to the Fathers that is heaven-going.

verses.sa:
बभ्रे रक्षः समदमा वपैभ्योऽब्राह्मणा यतमे त्वोपसीदान् ।
पुरीषिणः प्रथमानाः पुरस्तादार्षेयास्ते मा रिषन् प्राशितारः ॥
verses.rom:
babhre rakshah samadama vapaibhyo'brahmana yatame tvopasidan |
purishinah prathamanah purastadarsheyaste ma rishan prashitarah ||
verses.en: O bearing one, [as] a demon, strew discord for them, for whatsoever non-Brahmans shall sit by thee; rich in ground (? purīṣín), spreading themselves forward, let not them of the seers, partakers of thee, suffer harm.

verses.sa:
आर्षेयेषु नि दध ओदन त्वा नानार्षेयाणामप्यस्त्यत्र ।
अग्निर्मे गोप्ता मरुतश्च सर्वे विश्वे देवा अभि रक्षन्तु पक्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
arsheyeshu ni dadha odana tva nanarsheyanamapyastyatra |
agnirme gopta marutashcha sarve vishve deva abhi rakshantu pakvam ||
verses.en: I set thee down, O rice-dish, among them of the seers; for them that are not of the seers there is no portion here; let Agni my guardian, and all the Maruts, let all the gods defend the cooked [offering].

verses.sa:
यज्ञं दुहानं सदमित्प्रपीनं पुमांसं धेनुं सदनं रयीणाम् ।
प्रजामृतत्वमुत दीर्घमायू रायश्च पोषैरुप त्वा सदेम ॥
verses.rom:
yajnam duhanam sadamitprapinam pumamsam dhenum sadanam rayinam |
prajamritatvamuta dirghamayu rayashcha poshairupa tva sadema ||
verses.en: The offering, yielding milk (duh), constantly full (prápīna), a male (púmāṅs) milch-cow, seat of wealth, immortality through offspring, and a long life-time—and may we sit by thee with abundance (pl.) of wealth.

verses.sa:
वृषभोऽसि स्वर्ग ऋषीन् आर्षेयान् गच्छ ।
सुकृतां लोके सीद तत्र नौ संस्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
vrishabho'si svarga rishin arsheyan gachchha |
sukritam loke sida tatra nau samskritam ||
verses.en: Thou art a heaven-going bull; go to the seers, to them of the seers; sit in the world of the well-doing; there is there preparation (saṁskṛtá) for us both.

verses.sa:
समाचिनुष्वानुसंप्रयाह्यग्ने पथः कल्पय देवयानान् ।
एतैः सुकृतैरनु गच्छेम यज्ञं नाके तिष्ठन्तमधि सप्तरश्मौ ॥
verses.rom:
samachinushvanusamprayahyagne pathah kalpaya devayanan |
etaih sukritairanu gachchhema yajnam nake tishthantamadhi saptarashmau ||
verses.en: Gather thou together unto, go thou together forth after; O Agni, make ready (kalpay-) the roads traveled by the gods; by them, well-made, may we go after the offering, that stands upon the seven-rayed firmament.

verses.sa:
येन देवा ज्योतिषा द्यामुदायन् ब्रह्मौदनं पक्त्वा सुकृतस्य लोकम् ।
तेन गेष्म सुकृतस्य लोकं स्वरारोहन्तो अभि नाकमुत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
yena deva jyotisha dyamudayan brahmaudanam paktva sukritasya lokam |
tena geshma sukritasya lokam svararohanto abhi nakamuttamam ||
verses.en: With what light the gods went up to the sky, having cooked the brahmán-rice-dish, to the world of the well-done, with that may we go to the world of the well-done, ascending the heaven, unto the highest firmament.

verses.sa:
भवाशर्वौ मृडतं माभि यातं भूतपती पशुपती नमो वाम् ।
प्रतिहितामायतां मा वि स्राष्टं मा नो हिंसिष्टं द्विपदो मा चतुष्पदः ॥
verses.rom:
bhavasharvau mridatam mabhi yatam bhutapati pashupati namo vam |
pratihitamayatam ma vi srashtam ma no himsishtam dvipado ma chatushpadah ||
verses.en: O Bhava-and-Çarva, be gracious; do not go against [us]; ye lords of beings, lords of cattle, homage to you! [the arrow] that is fitted, that is drawn, do not let fly; do not harm our bipeds nor quadrupeds.

verses.sa:
शुने क्रोष्ट्रे मा शरीराणि कर्तमलिक्लवेभ्यो गृध्रेभ्यो ये च कृष्णा अविष्यवः ।
मक्षिकास्ते पशुपते वयांसि ते विघसे मा विदन्त ॥
verses.rom:
shune kroshtre ma sharirani kartamaliklavebhyo gridhrebhyo ye cha krishna avishyavah |
makshikaste pashupate vayamsi te vighase ma vidanta ||
verses.en: Make ye not bodies for the dog, the jackal, for the buzzards (? alíklava), the vultures, and them that are black [and] greedy (aviṣyú); let thy flies, lord of cattle, let thy birds not find themselves at food.

verses.sa:
क्रन्दाय ते प्राणाय याश्च ते भव रोपयः ।
नमस्ते रुद्र कृण्मः सहस्राक्षायामर्त्य ॥
verses.rom:
krandaya te pranaya yashcha te bhava ropayah |
namaste rudra krinmah sahasrakshayamartya ||
verses.en: Unto thy noise (? kránda), [thy] breath, and what pangs (? rópi) are thine, O Bhava—homage we pay to thee that art thousand-eyed, O Rudra, immortal one.

verses.sa:
पुरस्तात्ते नमः कृण्म उत्तरादधरादुत ।
अभीवर्गाद्दिवस्पर्यन्तरिक्षाय ते नमः ॥
verses.rom:
purastatte namah krinma uttaradadharaduta |
abhivargaddivasparyantarikshaya te namah ||
verses.en: We pay thee homage in front, above, also below; forth from the sphere of the sky, homage [be] to thine atmosphere.

verses.sa:
मुखाय ते पशुपते यानि चक्षूंषि ते भव ।
त्वचे रूपाय संदृशे प्रतीचीनाय ते नमः ॥
verses.rom:
mukhaya te pashupate yani chakshumshi te bhava |
tvache rupaya samdrishe pratichinaya te namah ||
verses.en: To thy face, O lord of cattle; the eyes that thou hast, O Bhava; to [thy] skin, form, aspect, to thee standing opposite [be] homage.

verses.sa:
अङ्गेभ्यस्त उदराय जिह्वाया आस्याय ते ।
दद्भ्यो गन्धाय ते नमः ॥
verses.rom:
angebhyasta udaraya jihvaya asyaya te |
dadbhyo gandhaya te namah ||
verses.en: To thy members, belly, tongue, thy mouth, to thy teeth, smell, [be] homage.

verses.sa:
अस्त्रा नीलशिखण्डेन सहस्राक्षेण वाजिना ।
रुद्रेणार्धकघातिना तेन मा समरामहि ॥
verses.rom:
astra nilashikhandena sahasrakshena vajina |
rudrenardhakaghatina tena ma samaramahi ||
verses.en: With the blue-locked archer, the thousand-eyed, vigorous, with Rudra, the half-smiter (?)—with him may we not come into collision (sam-ṛ).

verses.sa:
स नो भवः परि वृणक्तु विश्वत आप इवाग्निः परि वृणक्तु नो भवः ।
मा नोऽभि मांस्त नमो अस्त्वस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
sa no bhavah pari vrinaktu vishvata apa ivagnih pari vrinaktu no bhavah |
ma no'bhi mamsta namo astvasmai ||
verses.en: Let this Bhava avoid us on every side; as fire the waters, let Bhava avoid us; let him not plot against us; homage be to him.

verses.sa:
चतुर्नमो अष्टकृत्वो भवाय दश कृत्वः पशुपते नमस्ते ।
तवेमे पञ्च पशवो विभक्ता गावो अश्वाः पुरुषा अजावयः ॥
verses.rom:
chaturnamo ashtakritvo bhavaya dasha kritvah pashupate namaste |
taveme pancha pashavo vibhakta gavo ashvah purusha ajavayah ||
verses.en: Four times catús homage, eight times, to Bhava; ten times, O lord of cattle, be homage to thee; thine are shared out these five creatures (paçú)—cows, horses, men, sheep and goats.

verses.sa:
तव चतस्रः प्रदिशस्तव द्यौस्तव पृथिवी तवेदमुग्रोर्वन्तरिक्षम् ।
तवेदं सर्वमात्मन्वद्यत्प्राणत्पृथिवीमनु ॥
verses.rom:
tava chatasrah pradishastava dyaustava prithivi tavedamugrorvantariksham |
tavedam sarvamatmanvadyatpranatprithivimanu ||
verses.en: Thine are the four directions, thine the heaven, thine the earth, thine, O formidable one, this wide atmosphere, thine is all this that has life (ātmán), that is breathing upon (ánu) the earth.

verses.sa:
उरुः कोशो वसुधानस्तवायं यस्मिन्न् इमा विश्वा भुवनान्यन्तः ।
स नो मृड पशुपते नमस्ते परः क्रोष्टारो अभिभाः श्वानः परो यन्त्वघरुदो विकेश्यः ॥
verses.rom:
uruh kosho vasudhanastavayam yasminn ima vishva bhuvananyantah |
sa no mrida pashupate namaste parah kroshtaro abhibhah shvanah paro yantvagharudo vikeshyah ||
verses.en: This wide vessel, holder of good things, is thine, within which are all these beings; do thou be gracious to us, O lord of cattle; homage to thee; away let the jackals, the portents (abhibhā́), the dogs go, away the weepers of evil with disheveled hair.

verses.sa:
धनुर्बिभर्षि हरितं हिरण्ययं सहस्रघ्निं शतवधं शिखण्डिन् ।
रुद्रस्येषुश्चरति देवहेतिस्तस्यै नमो यतमस्यां दिशीतः ॥
verses.rom:
dhanurbibharshi haritam hiranyayam sahasraghnim shatavadham shikhandin |
rudrasyeshushcharati devahetistasyai namo yatamasyam dishitah ||
verses.en: Thou bearest a yellow golden bow, a thousand-slaying, hundred-weaponed, O tufted one; Rudra's arrow goes, a god-missile; to that be homage, in whichever direction from here.

verses.sa:
योऽभियातो निलयते त्वां रुद्र निचिकीर्षति ।
पश्चादनुप्रयुङ्क्षे तं विद्धस्य पदनीरिव ॥
verses.rom:
yo'bhiyato nilayate tvam rudra nichikirshati |
pashchadanuprayunkshe tam viddhasya padaniriva ||
verses.en: He who, attacked (abhi-yā), hides himself, [who] tries to put thee down, O Rudra, him from behind thou pursuest, like the tracker (? padanī́) of one that is pierced.

verses.sa:
भवारुद्रौ सयुजा संविदानावुभावुग्रौ चरतो वीर्याय ।
ताभ्यां नमो यतमस्यां दिशीतः ॥
verses.rom:
bhavarudrau sayuja samvidanavubhavugrau charato viryaya |
tabhyam namo yatamasyam dishitah ||
verses.en: Bhava-and-Rudra, allied, in concord, both go about, formidable, unto heroism; to them be homage, in whichever direction from here.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते अस्त्वायते नमो अस्तु परायते ।
नमस्ते रुद्र तिष्ठत आसीनायोत ते नमः ॥
verses.rom:
namaste astvayate namo astu parayate |
namaste rudra tishthata asinayota te namah ||
verses.en: Homage be to thee coming, homage be [to thee] going away; homage to thee, O Rudra, standing; to thee sitting also [be] homage.

verses.sa:
नमः सायं नमः प्रातर्नमो रात्र्या नमो दिवा ।
भवाय च शर्वाय चोभाभ्यामकरं नमः ॥
verses.rom:
namah sayam namah pratarnamo ratrya namo diva |
bhavaya cha sharvaya chobhabhyamakaram namah ||
verses.en: Homage in the evening, homage in the morning, homage by night, homage by day; to Bhava and to Çarva, to both have I paid homage.

verses.sa:
सहस्राक्षमतिपश्यं पुरस्ताद्रुद्रमस्यन्तं बहुधा विपश्चितम् ।
मोपाराम जिह्वयेयमानम् ॥
verses.rom:
sahasrakshamatipashyam purastadrudramasyantam bahudha vipashchitam |
moparama jihvayeyamanam ||
verses.en: With the thousand-eyed one, seeing across in front, with Rudra, hurling in many places, inspired one, may we not come in collision, as he goes about (ī́ya-) with the tongue.

verses.sa:
श्यावाश्वं कृष्णमसितं मृणन्तं भीमं रथं केशिनः पादयन्तम् ।
पूर्वे प्रतीमो नमो अस्त्वस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
shyavashvam krishnamasitam mrinantam bhimam ratham keshinah padayantam |
purve pratimo namo astvasmai ||
verses.en: We go forward (pū́rva) to meet him of dark horses, black, swarthy, killing, fearful, making to fall the chariot of the hairy one (keçín); homage be to him.

verses.sa:
मा नोऽभि स्रा मत्यं देवहेतिं मा नः क्रुधः पशुपते नमस्ते ।
अन्यत्रास्मद्दिव्यां शाखां वि धूनु ॥
verses.rom:
ma no'bhi sra matyam devahetim ma nah krudhah pashupate namaste |
anyatrasmaddivyam shakham vi dhunu ||
verses.en: Do not let fly at us the club (? matyà), the god-missile; be not angry at us, O lord of cattle; homage to thee; elsewhere than [over] us shake out the heavenly bough.

verses.sa:
मा नो हिंसीरधि नो ब्रूहि परि णो वृङ्धि मा क्रुधः ।
मा त्वया समरामहि ॥
verses.rom:
ma no himsiradhi no bruhi pari no vrindhi ma krudhah |
ma tvaya samaramahi ||
verses.en: Do not harm us; bless us; avoid us; be not angry; let us not come into collision with thee.

verses.sa:
मा नो गोषु पुरुषेषु मा गृधो नो अजाविषु ।
अन्यत्रोग्र वि वर्तय पियारूणां प्रजां जहि ॥
verses.rom:
ma no goshu purusheshu ma gridho no ajavishu |
anyatrogra vi vartaya piyarunam prajam jahi ||
verses.en: [Be] not [greedy] for our kine, our men; be not greedy for our goats and sheep; elsewhere, O formidable one, roll forth [thy missile]; smite the progeny of the mockers (píyāru).

verses.sa:
यस्य तक्मा कासिका हेतिरेकमश्वस्येव वृषणः क्रन्द एति ।
अभिपूर्वं निर्णयते नमो अस्त्वस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
yasya takma kasika hetirekamashvasyeva vrishanah kranda eti |
abhipurvam nirnayate namo astvasmai ||
verses.en: Of whom the takmán, the kā́sikā, goes as one weapon, like the noise of a stallion horse, to him, leading out in succession, be homage.

verses.sa:
योऽन्तरिक्षे तिष्ठति विष्टभितोऽयज्वनः प्रमृणन् देवपीयून् ।
तस्मै नमो दशभिः शक्वरीभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yo'ntarikshe tishthati vishtabhito'yajvanah pramrinan devapiyun |
tasmai namo dashabhih shakvaribhih ||
verses.en: He who stands propped up in the atmosphere, killing the non-sacrificing, the god-mockers—to him be homage with the ten clever ones (çákvarī).

verses.sa:
तुभ्यमारण्याः पशवो मृगा वने हिता हंसाः सुपर्णाः शकुना वयांसि ।
तव यक्षं पशुपते अप्स्वन्तस्तुभ्यं क्षरन्ति दिव्या आपो वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyamaranyah pashavo mriga vane hita hamsah suparnah shakuna vayamsi |
tava yaksham pashupate apsvantastubhyam ksharanti divya apo vridhe ||
verses.en: To thee are assigned the forest animals paçú, the wild beasts in the woods, the geese (haṅsá), eagles, hawks, birds; thine, O lord of cattle, is the monster (? yakṣá) within the waters; for thine increase flow the waters of the heaven.

verses.sa:
शिंशुमारा अजगराः पुरीकया जषा मत्स्या रजसा येभ्यो अस्यसि ।
न ते दूरं न परिष्ठास्ति ते भव सद्यः सर्वां परि पश्यसि भूमिं पूर्वस्माद्धंस्युत्तरस्मिन्त्समुद्रे ॥
verses.rom:
shimshumara ajagarah purikaya jasha matsya rajasa yebhyo asyasi |
na te duram na parishthasti te bhava sadyah sarvam pari pashyasi bhumim purvasmaddhamsyuttarasmintsamudre ||
verses.en: The dolphins (çiṅçumā́ra), boas (ajagará), purīkáyas, jashás, fishes, rajasás, at which thou hurlest: there is no distance for thee nor hindrance for thee, O Bhava; at once thou loolcest over the whole earth; from the eastern thou smitest in the northern ocean.

verses.sa:
मा नो रुद्र तक्मना मा विषेण मा नः सं स्रा दिव्येनाग्निना ।
अन्यत्रास्मद्विद्युतं पातयैताम् ॥
verses.rom:
ma no rudra takmana ma vishena ma nah sam sra divyenagnina |
anyatrasmadvidyutam patayaitam ||
verses.en: Do not, O Rudra, unite (sam-sṛj) us with the takmán, not with poison, not with the fire of heaven; elsewhere than [on] us make that lightning fall.

verses.sa:
भवो दिवो भव ईशे पृथिव्या भव आ पप्र उर्वन्तरिक्षम् ।
तस्यै नमो यतमस्यां दिशीतः ॥
verses.rom:
bhavo divo bhava ishe prithivya bhava a papra urvantariksham |
tasyai namo yatamasyam dishitah ||
verses.en: Bhava is master (īç) of the heaven, Bhava of the earth; Bhava has filled the wide atmosphere; to him be homage, in whichever direction from here.

verses.sa:
भव राजन् यजमानाय मृड पशूनां हि पशुपतिर्बभूथ ।
यः श्रद्दधाति सन्ति देवा इति चतुष्पदे द्विपदेऽस्य मृड ॥
verses.rom:
bhava rajan yajamanaya mrida pashunam hi pashupatirbabhutha |
yah shraddadhati santi deva iti chatushpade dvipade'sya mrida ||
verses.en: O king Bhava, be gracious to the sacrificer, for thou hast become cattle-lord of cattle; whoever has faith, saying "the gods are," be thou gracious to his bipeds [and] quadrupeds.

verses.sa:
मा नो महान्तमुत मा नो अर्भकं मा नो वहन्तमुत मा नो वक्ष्यतः ।
मा नो हिंसीः पितरं मातरं च स्वां तन्वं रुद्र मा रीरिषो नः ॥
verses.rom:
ma no mahantamuta ma no arbhakam ma no vahantamuta ma no vakshyatah |
ma no himsih pitaram mataram cha svam tanvam rudra ma ririsho nah ||
verses.en: Not our great one, and not our small, not our carrying one, and not those that will carry, not our father and mother do thou harm; our own self (tanū́), O Rudra, do not injure.

verses.sa:
रुद्रस्यैलबकारेभ्योऽसंसूक्तगिलेभ्यः ।
इदं महास्येभ्यः श्वभ्यो अकरं नमः ॥
verses.rom:
rudrasyailabakarebhyo'samsuktagilebhyah |
idam mahasyebhyah shvabhyo akaram namah ||
verses.en: To Rudra's howl-making, unhymned-swallowing (?), great-mouthed dogs I have paid this homage.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते घोषिणीभ्यो नमस्ते केशिनीभ्यः ।
नमो नमस्कृताभ्यो नमः संभुञ्जतीभ्यः ।
नमस्ते देव सेनाभ्यः स्वस्ति नो अभयं च नः ॥
verses.rom:
namaste ghoshinibhyo namaste keshinibhyah |
namo namaskritabhyo namah sambhunjatibhyah |
namaste deva senabhyah svasti no abhayam cha nah ||
verses.en: Homage to thy noisy ones, homage to thy hairy ones, homage to those to whom homage is paid, homage to the jointly-enjoying—homage, [namely], O god, to thine armies; welfare [be] to us, and fearlessness to us.

verses.sa: तस्यौदनस्य बृहस्पतिः शिरो ब्रह्म मुखम् ॥
verses.rom: tasyaudanasya brihaspatih shiro brahma mukham ||
verses.en: Of this rice-dish Brihaspati is the head, Brahman the mouth (múkha).

verses.sa: द्यावापृथिवी श्रोत्रे सूर्याचन्द्रमसावक्षिणी सप्तऋषयः प्राणापानाः ॥
verses.rom: dyavaprithivi shrotre suryachandramasavakshini saptarishayah pranapanah ||
verses.en: Heaven-and-earth are the ears, sun-and-moon the eyes, the seven seers the breaths-and-expirations.

verses.sa: चक्षुर्मुसलं काम उलूखलम् ॥
verses.rom: chakshurmusalam kama ulukhalam ||
verses.en: Sight (cákṣus) the pestle, desire (kā́ma) the mortar.

verses.sa: दितिः शूर्पमदितिः शूर्पग्राही वातोऽपाविनक् ॥
verses.rom: ditih shurpamaditih shurpagrahi vato'pavinak ||
verses.en: Diti the winnowing basket, Aditi the basket-holder; the wind winnowed (apa-vic).

verses.sa: अश्वाः कणा गावस्तण्डुला मशकास्तुषाः ॥
verses.rom: ashvah kana gavastandula mashakastushah ||
verses.en: Horses the corns (káṇa), kine the grains (taṇḍulá), flies the husks.

verses.sa: कब्रु फलीकरणाः शरोऽभ्रम् ॥
verses.rom: kabru phalikaranah sharo'bhram ||
verses.en: Kábru the hulls, the cloud the stalk (çára).

verses.sa: श्याममयोऽस्य मांसानि लोहितमस्य लोहितम् ॥
verses.rom: shyamamayo'sya mamsani lohitamasya lohitam ||
verses.en: Dark metal its flesh, red its blood (lóhita).

verses.sa: त्रपु भस्म हरितं वर्णः पुष्करमस्य गन्धः ॥
verses.rom: trapu bhasma haritam varnah pushkaramasya gandhah ||
verses.en: Tin [its] ash, greens (? háritam) [its] color, blue lotus (púṣkara) its smell.

verses.sa: खलः पात्रं स्फ्यावंसावीषे अनूक्ये ॥
verses.rom: khalah patram sphyavamsavishe anukye ||
verses.en: The threshing-floor [its] receptacle, the two splints (sphyá) [its] shoulders, the two poles (īṣā́) [its] spines (anūkyā̀).

verses.sa: आन्त्राणि जत्रवो गुदा वरत्राः ॥
verses.rom: antrani jatravo guda varatrah ||
verses.en: Entrails [its] 'neck-ropes (? jatrú), intestines [its] straps.

verses.sa: इयमेव पृथिवी कुम्भी भवति राध्यमानस्यौदनस्य द्यौरपिधानम् ॥
verses.rom: iyameva prithivi kumbhi bhavati radhyamanasyaudanasya dyaurapidhanam ||
verses.en: This very earth is the vessel (kumbhī́) of the finishing (rādh) rice-dish, heaven the cover.

verses.sa: सीताः पर्शवः सिकता ऊबध्यम् ॥
verses.rom: sitah parshavah sikata ubadhyam ||
verses.en: The furrows [its] ribs, gravel the content of [its] bowels.

verses.sa: ऋतं हस्तावनेजनं कुल्योपसेचनम् ॥
verses.rom: ritam hastavanejanam kulyopasechanam ||
verses.en: Righteousness (ṛtá) [its] hand-washing, the brook (kulyā̀) [its] pouring-on.

verses.sa: ऋचा कुम्भ्यधिहितार्त्विज्येन प्रेषिता ॥
verses.rom: richa kumbhyadhihitartvijyena preshita ||
verses.en: With sacred verse (ṛ́c) is the vessel put on, with priesthood sent forth;

verses.sa: ब्रह्मणा परिगृहीता साम्ना पर्यूढा ॥
verses.rom: brahmana parigrihita samna paryudha ||
verses.en: With sacredness (bráhman) seized about, with sacred chant (sā́man) carried about.

verses.sa: बृहदायवनं रथन्तरं दर्विः ॥
verses.rom: brihadayavanam rathantaram darvih ||
verses.en: Bṛhát the stirring-stick, rathaṁtará the spoon.

verses.sa: ऋतवः पक्तार आर्तवाः समिन्धते ॥
verses.rom: ritavah paktara artavah samindhate ||
verses.en: The seasons the cooks; they of the seasons kindle fire.

verses.sa: चरुं पञ्चबिलमुखं घर्मोऽभीन्धे ॥
verses.rom: charum panchabilamukham gharmo'bhindhe ||
verses.en: Heat (gharmá) burns upon the pot of five openings, the boiler (ukhá).

verses.sa: ओदनेन यज्ञवतः सर्वे लोकाः समाप्याः ॥
verses.rom: odanena yajnavatah sarve lokah samapyah ||
verses.en: By the rice-dish of him who hath an offering (?) all worlds are to be obtained together.

verses.sa: यस्मिन्त्समुद्रो द्यौर्भूमिस्त्रयोऽवरपरं श्रिताः ॥
verses.rom: yasmintsamudro dyaurbhumistrayo'varaparam shritah ||
verses.en: In which rice-dish are set (çritá), one below the other, the three, sea, sky, earth.

verses.sa: यस्य देवा अकल्पन्तोच्छिष्टे षडशीतयः ॥
verses.rom: yasya deva akalpantochchhishte shadashitayah ||
verses.en: In the remnant (úchiṣṭa) of which took shape six times eighty gods.

verses.sa: तं त्वौदनस्य पृच्छामि यो अस्य महिमा महान् ॥
verses.rom: tam tvaudanasya prichchhami yo asya mahima mahan ||
verses.en: Thee here I ask of the rice-dish, what is its great greatness.

verses.sa: स य ओदनस्य महिमानं विद्यात् ॥
verses.rom: sa ya odanasya mahimanam vidyat ||
verses.en: He who may know the greatness of the rice-dish—

verses.sa: नाल्प इति ब्रूयान् नानुपसेचन इति नेदं च किं चेति ॥
verses.rom: nalpa iti bruyan nanupasechana iti nedam cha kim cheti ||
verses.en: May not say "[it is] little," not "[it is] without onpouring," nor "[it is] this thing soever."

verses.sa: यावद्दाताभिमनस्येत तन् नाति वदेत् ॥
verses.rom: yavaddatabhimanasyeta tan nati vadet ||
verses.en: As much as the giver may set his mind upon, that one should not overbid (ati-vad).

verses.sa: ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति पराञ्चमोदनं प्राशी३ः प्रत्यञ्चा३ इति ॥
verses.rom: brahmavadino vadanti paranchamodanam prashi3h pratyancha3 iti ||
verses.en: The theologues (brahmavādín) say: hast thou eaten (pra-aç) the rice-dish as it was retiring (párāñc), or as it was coming on (pratyáñc)?

verses.sa: त्वमोदनं प्राशी३ त्वामोदना३ इति ॥
verses.rom: tvamodanam prashi3 tvamodana3 iti ||
verses.en: Hast thou eaten the rice-dish, or the rice-dish thee?

verses.sa: पराञ्चं चैनं प्राशीः प्राणास्त्वा हास्यन्तीत्येनमाह ॥
verses.rom: parancham chainam prashih pranastva hasyantityenamaha ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it retiring, thy breaths (prāṇá) will quit thee: so one says to him.

verses.sa: प्रत्यञ्चं चैनं प्राशीरपानास्त्वा हास्यन्तीत्येनमाह ॥
verses.rom: pratyancham chainam prashirapanastva hasyantityenamaha ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it coming on, thine expirations (apāná) will quit thee: so one says to him.

verses.sa: नैवाहमोदनं न मामोदनः ॥
verses.rom: naivahamodanam na mamodanah ||
verses.en: Not I, indeed, [have eaten] the rice-dish, nor the rice-dish me.

verses.sa: ओदन एवौदनं प्राशीत् ॥
verses.rom: odana evaudanam prashit ||
verses.en: The rice-dish itself hath eaten the rice-dish.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्येन शीर्ष्णा प्राशीर्येन चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
ज्येष्ठतस्ते प्रजा मरिष्यतीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
बृहस्पतिना शीर्ष्णा ।
तेनैनं प्राशिषं तेनैनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyena shirshna prashiryena chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
jyeshthataste praja marishyatityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
brihaspatina shirshna |
tenainam prashisham tenainamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If ca thou hast eaten it with another head than that (tátas) with which the ancient seers ate this, thy progeny, from the oldest down, will die: so one says to him; it verily I [have] not [eaten] coming hither (arvā́ñc), nor retiring, nor coming on; with Brihaspati [as] head, therewith have I eaten it, therewith have I made it go; this rice-dish, verily, is whole-limbed, whole-jointed, whole-bodied; whole-limbed, whole-jointed, whole-bodied becometh he who knoweth thus.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्याभ्यां श्रोत्राभ्यां प्राशीर्याभ्यां चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
बधिरो भविष्यसीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां श्रोत्राभ्याम् ।
ताभ्यामेनं प्राशिषं ताभ्यामेनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyabhyam shrotrabhyam prashiryabhyam chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
badhiro bhavishyasityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
dyavaprithivibhyam shrotrabhyam |
tabhyamenam prashisham tabhyamenamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with other ears than those tátas with which the ancient seers ate this, thou wilt become deaf: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with heaven-and-earth as ears, with them have I eaten it, with them have I made it go etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्याभ्यामक्षीभ्यां प्राशीर्याभ्यां चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
अन्धो भविष्यसीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
सूर्याचन्द्रमसाभ्यामक्षीभ्याम् ।
ताभ्यामेनं प्राशिषं ताभ्यामेनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyabhyamakshibhyam prashiryabhyam chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
andho bhavishyasityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
suryachandramasabhyamakshibhyam |
tabhyamenam prashisham tabhyamenamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with other eyes than those with which the ancient seers ate this, thou wilt become blind: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with sun-and-moon as eyes, with them have I eaten it, with them etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्येन मुखेन प्राशीर्येन चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
मुखतस्ते प्रजा मरिष्यतीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
ब्रह्मणा मुखेन ।
तेनैनं प्राशिषं तेनैनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyena mukhena prashiryena chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
mukhataste praja marishyatityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
brahmana mukhena |
tenainam prashisham tenainamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with another mouth (múkha) than that with which the ancient seers ate this, thy progeny will die from in front (mukhatás): thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with bráhman as mouth, therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्यया जिह्वया प्राशीर्यया चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
जिह्वा ते मरिष्यतीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
अग्नेर्जिह्वया ।
तयैनं प्राशिषं तयैनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyaya jihvaya prashiryaya chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
jihva te marishyatityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
agnerjihvaya |
tayainam prashisham tayainamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with another tongue than that with which the ancient seers ate this, thy tongue will die: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with Agni's tongue, therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्यैर्दन्तैः प्राशीर्यैश्चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
दन्तास्ते शत्स्यन्तीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
ऋतुभिर्दन्तैः ।
तैरेनं प्राशिषं तैरेनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyairdantaih prashiryaishchaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
dantaste shatsyantityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
ritubhirdantaih |
tairenam prashisham tairenamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with other teeth than those with which the ancient seers ate this, thy teeth will fall out (çad): thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with the seasons as teeth, therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्यैः प्राणापानैः प्राशीर्यैश्चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
प्राणापानास्त्वा हास्यन्तीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
सप्तऋषिभिः प्राणापानैः ।
तैरेनं प्राशिषं तैरेनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyaih pranapanaih prashiryaishchaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
pranapanastva hasyantityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
saptarishibhih pranapanaih |
tairenam prashisham tairenamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with other breaths-and-expirations than those with which the ancient seers ate this, breaths-and-expirations will quit thee: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with the seven seers as breaths-and-expirations, therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्येन व्यचसा प्राशीर्येन चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
राजयक्ष्मस्त्वा हनिष्यतीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
अन्तरिक्षेण व्यचसा ।
तेनैनं प्राशिषं तेनैनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyena vyachasa prashiryena chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
rajayakshmastva hanishyatityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
antarikshena vyachasa |
tenainam prashisham tenainamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with another bulk (vyácas) than that with which the ancient seers ate this, the king-yákshma will slay thee: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with the atmosphere as bulk, therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्येन पृष्ठेन प्राशीर्येन चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
विद्युत्त्वा हनिष्यतीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
दिवा पृष्ठेन ।
तेनैनं प्राशिषं तेनैनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyena prishthena prashiryena chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
vidyuttva hanishyatityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
diva prishthena |
tenainam prashisham tenainamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with another back than that with which the ancient seers ate this, the lightning will slay thee: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with the sky as back, therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्येनोरसा प्राशीर्येन चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
कृष्या न रात्स्यसीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
पृथिव्योरसा ।
तेनैनं प्राशिषं तेनैनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyenorasa prashiryena chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
krishya na ratsyasityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
prithivyorasa |
tenainam prashisham tenainamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with another breast than that with which the ancient seers ate this, thou wilt not prosper with plowing: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with the earth as breast, therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्येनोदरेण प्राशीर्येन चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
उदरदारस्त्वा हनिष्यतीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
सत्येनोदरेण ।
तेनैनं प्राशिषं तेनैनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyenodarena prashiryena chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
udaradarastva hanishyatityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
satyenodarena |
tenainam prashisham tenainamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with another belly than that with which the ancient seers ate this, the colic (? udaradārá) will slay thee: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with truth as belly, therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्येन वस्तिना प्राशीर्येन चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
अप्सु मरिष्यसीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
समुद्रेण वस्तिना ।
तेनैनं प्राशिषं तेनैनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyena vastina prashiryena chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
apsu marishyasityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
samudrena vastina |
tenainam prashisham tenainamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with another bladder than that with which the ancient seers ate this, thou wilt die in the waters: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with the ocean as bladder, therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्याभ्यामूरुभ्यां प्राशीर्याभ्यां चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
ऊरू ते मरिष्यत इत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
मित्रावरुणयोरूरुभ्याम् ।
ताभ्यामेनं प्राशिषं ताभ्यामेनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyabhyamurubhyam prashiryabhyam chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
uru te marishyata ityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
mitravarunayorurubhyam |
tabhyamenam prashisham tabhyamenamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with other thighs than those with which the ancient seers ate this, thy thighs will die: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with the thighs of Mitra-and-Varuṇa, therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्याभ्यामष्ठीवद्भ्यां प्राशीर्याभ्यां चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
स्रामो भविष्यसीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
त्वष्टुरष्ठीवद्भ्याम् ।
ताभ्यामेनं प्राशिषं ताभ्यामेनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyabhyamashthivadbhyam prashiryabhyam chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
sramo bhavishyasityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
tvashturashthivadbhyam |
tabhyamenam prashisham tabhyamenamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with other knees (aṣṭhīvánt) than those with which the ancient seers ate this, thou wilt become lame: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with Tvashṭar's knees, therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्याभ्यां पादाभ्यां प्राशीर्याभ्यां चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
बहुचारी भविष्यसीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
अश्विनोः पादाभ्याम् ।
ताभ्यामेनं प्राशिषं ताभ्यामेनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyabhyam padabhyam prashiryabhyam chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
bahuchari bhavishyasityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
ashvinoh padabhyam |
tabhyamenam prashisham tabhyamenamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with other feet than those with which the ancient seers ate this, thou wilt be much-wandering: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with the feet of the two Açvins, therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्याभ्यां प्रपदाभ्यां प्राशीर्याभ्यां चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
सर्पस्त्वा हनिष्यतीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
सवितुः प्रपदाभ्याम् ।
ताभ्यामेनं प्राशिषं ताभ्यामेनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyabhyam prapadabhyam prashiryabhyam chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
sarpastva hanishyatityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
savituh prapadabhyam |
tabhyamenam prashisham tabhyamenamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with other front-feet than those with which the ancient seers ate this, a serpent will slay thee: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with Savitar's front-feet, therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्याभ्यां हस्ताभ्यां प्राशीर्याभ्यां चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
ब्राह्मणं हनिष्यसीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
ऋतस्य हस्ताभ्याम् ।
ताभ्यामेनं प्राशिषं ताभ्यामेनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyabhyam hastabhyam prashiryabhyam chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
brahmanam hanishyasityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
ritasya hastabhyam |
tabhyamenam prashisham tabhyamenamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with other hands than those with which the ancient seers ate this, thou wilt slay a Brahman: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; with the hands of righteousness (ṛtá), therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ततश्चैनमन्यया प्रतिष्ठया प्राशीर्यया चैतं पूर्व ऋषयः प्राश्नन् ।
अप्रतिष्ठानोऽनायतनो मरिष्यसीत्येनमाह ।
तं वा अहं नार्वाञ्चं न पराञ्चं न प्रत्यञ्चम् ।
सत्ये प्रतिष्ठाय ।
तयैनं प्राशिषं तयैनमजीगमम् ।
एष वा ओदनः सर्वाङ्गः सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः ।
सर्वाङ्ग एव सर्वपरुः सर्वतनूः सं भवति य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchainamanyaya pratishthaya prashiryaya chaitam purva rishayah prashnan |
apratishthano'nayatano marishyasityenamaha |
tam va aham narvancham na parancham na pratyancham |
satye pratishthaya |
tayainam prashisham tayainamajigamam |
esha va odanah sarvangah sarvaparuh sarvatanuh |
sarvanga eva sarvaparuh sarvatanuh sam bhavati ya evam veda ||
verses.en: If thou hast eaten it with another firm standing (pratiṣṭhā́) than that with which the ancient seers ate this, without firm standing, without support (āyátana) wilt thou die: thus one says to him; it verily [have] I not [eaten] coming hither, nor retiring, nor coming on; standing firm in truth, therewith have I etc. etc.

verses.sa: एतद्वै ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं यदोदनः ॥
verses.rom: etadvai bradhnasya vishtapam yadodanah ||
verses.en: This—namely, the rice-dish—is indeed the summit (viṣṭápa) of the ruddy one (bradhná).

verses.sa: ब्रध्नलोको भवति ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपि श्रयते य एवं वेद ॥
verses.rom: bradhnaloko bhavati bradhnasya vishtapi shrayate ya evam veda ||
verses.en: He cometh to have the ruddy one for his world, he resorteth (çri) to the summit of the ruddy one, who knoweth thus.

verses.sa: एतस्माद्वा ओदनात्त्रयस्त्रिंशतं लोकान् निरमिमीत प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.rom: etasmadva odanattrayastrimshatam lokan niramimita prajapatih ||
verses.en: Out of this rice-dish Prajāpati verily fashioned thirty-three worlds.

verses.sa: तेषां प्रज्ञानाय यज्ञमसृजत ॥
verses.rom: tesham prajnanaya yajnamasrijata ||
verses.en: In order to the knowledge (prajñā́na) of them he created the sacrifice.

verses.sa: स य एवं विदुष उपद्रष्टा भवति प्राणं रुणद्धि ॥
verses.rom: sa ya evam vidusha upadrashta bhavati pranam runaddhi ||
verses.en: He who becomes the on-looker (upadraṣṭṛ́) of one knowing thus stops [his own] breath.

verses.sa: न च प्राणं रुणद्धि सर्वज्यानिं जीयते ॥
verses.rom: na cha pranam runaddhi sarvajyanim jiyate ||
verses.en: If he does not stop [his own] breath, he is scathed a complete scathing.

verses.sa: न च सर्वज्यानिं जीयते पुरैनं जरसः प्राणो जहाति ॥
verses.rom: na cha sarvajyanim jiyate purainam jarasah prano jahati ||
verses.en: If he is not scathed a complete scathing, before old age breath quits him.

verses.sa:
प्राणाय नमो यस्य सर्वमिदं वशे ।
यो भूतः सर्वस्येश्वरो यस्मिन्त्सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
verses.rom:
pranaya namo yasya sarvamidam vashe |
yo bhutah sarvasyeshvaro yasmintsarvam pratishthitam ||
verses.en: Homage to breath (prāṇá) in whose control is this All, who hath been lord of all, in whom all stands firm.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते प्राण क्रन्दाय नमस्ते स्तनयित्नवे ।
नमस्ते प्राण विद्युते नमस्ते प्राण वर्षते ॥
verses.rom:
namaste prana krandaya namaste stanayitnave |
namaste prana vidyute namaste prana varshate ||
verses.en: Homage, O breath, to thy roaring, homage to thy thunder; homage, O breath, to thy lightning, homage to thee raining, O breath.

verses.sa:
यत्प्राण स्तनयित्नुनाभिक्रन्दत्योषधीः ।
प्र वीयन्ते गर्भान् दधतेऽथो बह्वीर्वि जायन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
yatprana stanayitnunabhikrandatyoshadhih |
pra viyante garbhan dadhate'tho bahvirvi jayante ||
verses.en: When breath with thunder roars at the herbs, they are impregnated (pra-vī), they receive embryos, then they are born many.

verses.sa:
यत्प्राण ऋतावागतेऽभिक्रन्दत्योषधीः ।
सर्वं तदा प्र मोदते यत्किं च भूम्यामधि ॥
verses.rom:
yatprana ritavagate'bhikrandatyoshadhih |
sarvam tada pra modate yatkim cha bhumyamadhi ||
verses.en: When, the season having come, breath roars at the herbs, then all is delighted, whatever is upon the earth.

verses.sa:
यदा प्राणो अभ्यवर्षीद्वर्षेण पृथिवीं महीम् ।
पशवस्तत्प्र मोदन्ते महो वै नो भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
yada prano abhyavarshidvarshena prithivim mahim |
pashavastatpra modante maho vai no bhavishyati ||
verses.en: When breath hath rained with rain upon the great earth, then the cattle are delighted: "verily there will be greatness for us."

verses.sa:
अभिवृष्टा ओषधयः प्राणेन समवादिरन् ।
आयुर्वै नः प्रातीतरः सर्वा नः सुरभीरकः ॥
verses.rom:
abhivrishta oshadhayah pranena samavadiran |
ayurvai nah pratitarah sarva nah surabhirakah ||
verses.en: The herbs, being rained on, have talked with breath: "verily thou hast extended our life-time; thou hast made us all fragrant."

verses.sa:
नमस्ते अस्त्वायते नमो अस्तु परायते ।
नमस्ते प्राण तिष्ठत आसीनायोत ते नमः ॥
verses.rom:
namaste astvayate namo astu parayate |
namaste prana tishthata asinayota te namah ||
verses.en: Homage be to thee coming, homage be to [thee] going away; homage to thee, O breath, standing; to thee sitting also [be] homage.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते प्राण प्राणते नमो अस्त्वपानते ।
पराचीनाय ते नमः प्रतीचीनाय ते नमः सर्वस्मै त इदं नमः ॥
verses.rom:
namaste prana pranate namo astvapanate |
parachinaya te namah pratichinaya te namah sarvasmai ta idam namah ||
verses.en: Homage to thee breathing, O breath; homage be to [thee] making expiration; homage to thee turned away, homage to thee turned toward [us]; to the whole of thee [be] this homage.

verses.sa:
या ते प्राण प्रिया तनूर्यो ते प्राण प्रेयसी ।
अथो यद्भेषजं तव तस्य नो धेहि जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
ya te prana priya tanuryo te prana preyasi |
atho yadbheshajam tava tasya no dhehi jivase ||
verses.en: The dear body that is thine, O breath, and the dearer one that is thine, O breath, likewise what remedy is thine, assign thou of it to us in order to life (jīvás).

verses.sa:
प्राणः प्रजा अनु वस्ते पिता पुत्रमिव प्रियम् ।
प्राणो ह सर्वस्येश्वरो यच्च प्राणति यच्च न ॥
verses.rom:
pranah praja anu vaste pita putramiva priyam |
prano ha sarvasyeshvaro yachcha pranati yachcha na ||
verses.en: Breath clothes (anu-vas) human beings (prajā́), as a father a dear son; breath is lord of all, both what breathes and what does not.

verses.sa:
प्राणो मृत्युः प्राणस्तक्मा प्राणं देवा उपासते ।
प्राणो ह सत्यवादिनमुत्तमे लोक आ दधत् ॥
verses.rom:
prano mrityuh pranastakma pranam deva upasate |
prano ha satyavadinamuttame loka a dadhat ||
verses.en: Breath [is] death, breath takmán; breath the gods worship (upa-ās); breath may set the truth-speaker in the highest world.

verses.sa:
प्राणो विराट्प्राणो देष्ट्री प्राणं सर्व उपासते ।
प्राणो ह सूर्यश्चन्द्रमाः प्राणमाहुः प्रजापतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
prano viratprano deshtri pranam sarva upasate |
prano ha suryashchandramah pranamahuh prajapatim ||
verses.en: Breath is virā́j, breath the directress; breath all worship; breath is the sun, the moon; breath they call Prajāpati.

verses.sa:
प्राणापानौ व्रीहियवावनड्वान् प्राण उच्यते ।
यवे ह प्राण आहितोऽपानो व्रीहिरुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
pranapanau vrihiyavavanadvan prana uchyate |
yave ha prana ahito'pano vrihiruchyate ||
verses.en: Breath-and-expiration are rice-and-barley; breath is called the draft-ox; breath is set in barley; expiration is called rice.

verses.sa:
अपानति प्राणति पुरुषो गर्भे अन्तरा ।
यदा त्वं प्राण जिन्वस्यथ स जायते पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
apanati pranati purusho garbhe antara |
yada tvam prana jinvasyatha sa jayate punah ||
verses.en: A man breathes out (ápānati), breathes (prā́ṇati) within the womb; when, O breath, thou quickenest, then he is born again.

verses.sa:
प्राणमाहुर्मातरिश्वानं वातो ह प्राण उच्यते ।
प्राणे ह भूतं भव्यं च प्राणे सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
verses.rom:
pranamahurmatarishvanam vato ha prana uchyate |
prane ha bhutam bhavyam cha prane sarvam pratishthitam ||
verses.en: Breath they call Mātariçvan; breath is called the wind; in breath what has been and what will be, in breath is all established (prátiṣṭhita).

verses.sa:
आथर्वणीराङ्गिरसीर्दैवीर्मनुष्यजा उत ।
ओषधयः प्र जायन्ते यदा त्वं प्राण जिन्वसि ॥
verses.rom:
atharvanirangirasirdaivirmanushyaja uta |
oshadhayah pra jayante yada tvam prana jinvasi ||
verses.en: They of the Atharvans, they of the An̄girases, they of the gods, also those born of men—the herbs are generated (pra-jā), when thou, O breath, quickenest.

verses.sa:
यदा प्राणो अभ्यवर्षीद्वर्षेण पृथिवीं महीम् ।
ओषधयः प्र जायन्तेऽथो याः काश्च वीरुधः ॥
verses.rom:
yada prano abhyavarshidvarshena prithivim mahim |
oshadhayah pra jayante'tho yah kashcha virudhah ||
verses.en: When breath hath rained with rain on the great earth, the herbs are generated, likewise whatever plants [there are].

verses.sa:
यस्ते प्राणेदं वेद यस्मिंश्चासि प्रतिष्ठितः ।
सर्वे तस्मै बलिं हरान् अमुष्मिंल्लोक उत्तमे ॥
verses.rom:
yaste pranedam veda yasmimshchasi pratishthitah |
sarve tasmai balim haran amushmimlloka uttame ||
verses.en: He who knoweth this of thee, O breath, and in whom thou art established—to him shall all bring tribute in yon highest world.

verses.sa:
यथा प्राण बलिहृतस्तुभ्यं सर्वाः प्रजा इमाः ।
एवा तस्मै बलिं हरान् यस्त्वा शृणवत्सुश्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha prana balihritastubhyam sarvah praja imah |
eva tasmai balim haran yastva shrinavatsushravah ||
verses.en: As, O breath, all these human beings (prajā́) are tribute-bearers to thee, so shall they bring tribute to him who shall hear thee, O thou of good report (suçrávas).

verses.sa:
अन्तर्गर्भश्चरति देवतास्वाभूतो भूतः स उ जायते पुनः ।
स भूतो भव्यं भविष्यत्पिता पुत्रं प्र विवेशा शचीभिः ॥
verses.rom:
antargarbhashcharati devatasvabhuto bhutah sa u jayate punah |
sa bhuto bhavyam bhavishyatpita putram pra vivesha shachibhih ||
verses.en: He moves, an embryo, within the divinities; having come into being (? ā́bhūta), having been (bhūtá), he is born again; he, having been, entered with might (çácībhis) what is to be, what will be, [as] a father a son.

verses.sa:
एकं पादं नोत्खिदति सलिलाद्धंस उच्चरन् ।
यदङ्ग स तमुत्खिदेन् नैवाद्य न श्वः स्यात्।
न रात्री नाहः स्यान् न व्युच्छेत्कदा चन ॥
verses.rom:
ekam padam notkhidati saliladdhamsa uchcharan |
yadanga sa tamutkhiden naivadya na shvah syat|
na ratri nahah syan na vyuchchhetkada chana ||
verses.en: The swan (haṅsá), ascending, does not extract (ut-khid) one foot from the sea; verily, if he should extract that, there would not be today nor tomorrow; there would not be night nor day; at no time soever would it dawn (vi-vas).

verses.sa:
अष्टाचक्रं वर्तत एकनेमि सहस्राक्षरं प्र पुरो नि पश्चा ।
अर्धेन विश्वं भुवनं जजान यदस्यार्धं कतमः स केतुः ॥
verses.rom:
ashtachakram vartata ekanemi sahasraksharam pra puro ni pashcha |
ardhena vishvam bhuvanam jajana yadasyardham katamah sa ketuh ||
verses.en: The eight-wheeled [thing, neut.] rolls, having one rim, thousand-syllabled, forth in front, down behind; with a half it has generated all existence; what its [other] half [is]—which sign is that?

verses.sa:
यो अस्य विश्वजन्मन ईशे विश्वस्य चेष्टतः ।
अन्येषु क्षिप्रधन्वने तस्मै प्राण नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
verses.rom:
yo asya vishvajanmana ishe vishvasya cheshtatah |
anyeshu kshipradhanvane tasmai prana namo'stu te ||
verses.en: He who is lord of this that has every (víçva) [kind of] birth, of every stirring thing—to thee being such, O breath, having a quick bow among the unexhausted (? ánya), be homage.

verses.sa:
यो अस्य सर्वजन्मन ईशे सर्वस्य चेष्टतः ।
अतन्द्रो ब्रह्मणा धीरः प्राणो मानु तिष्ठतु ॥
verses.rom:
yo asya sarvajanmana ishe sarvasya cheshtatah |
atandro brahmana dhirah prano manu tishthatu ||
verses.en: He who is lord of this that has all (sárva) [kinds of] birth, of all that stirs, unwearied, wise by bráhman—let breath go after (anu-sthā) me.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वः सुप्तेषु जागार ननु तिर्यङ्नि पद्यते ।
न सुप्तमस्य सुप्तेष्वनु शुश्राव कश्चन ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvah supteshu jagara nanu tiryanni padyate |
na suptamasya supteshvanu shushrava kashchana ||
verses.en: Upright among the sleeping he wakes; by no means (nanú) does he fall down horizontal (tiryán̄); no one soever has heard of his sleeping among the sleeping.

verses.sa:
प्राण मा मत्पर्यावृतो न मदन्यो भविष्यसि ।
अपां गर्भमिव जीवसे प्राण बध्नामि त्वा मयि ॥
verses.rom:
prana ma matparyavrito na madanyo bhavishyasi |
apam garbhamiva jivase prana badhnami tva mayi ||
verses.en: O breath, turn not about from me; not another than I shalt thou be; like the embryo of the waters, in order to life (jīvás), I bind thee to me, O breath.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचारीष्णंश्चरति रोदसी उभे तस्मिन् देवाः संमनसो भवन्ति ।
स दाधार पृथिवीं दिवं च स आचार्यं तपसा पिपर्ति ॥
verses.rom:
brahmacharishnamshcharati rodasi ubhe tasmin devah sammanaso bhavanti |
sa dadhara prithivim divam cha sa acharyam tapasa piparti ||
verses.en: The Vedic student goes on setting in motion (iṣ) both firmaments; in him the gods become like-minded; he maintains earth and heaven; he fills his teacher with fervor (tápas).

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचारिणं पितरो देवजनाः पृथग्देवा अनुसंयन्ति सर्वे ।
गन्धर्वा एनमन्वायन् त्रयस्त्रिंशत्त्रिशताः षट्सहस्राः सर्वान्त्स देवांस्तपसा पिपर्ति ॥
verses.rom:
brahmacharinam pitaro devajanah prithagdeva anusamyanti sarve |
gandharva enamanvayan trayastrimshattrishatah shatsahasrah sarvantsa devamstapasa piparti ||
verses.en: The Fathers, the god-folk, all the gods individually assemble after the Vedic student; the Gandharvas went after him, thirty-three, three hundred, six thousand; he fills all the gods with fervor.

verses.sa:
आचार्य उपनयमानो ब्रह्मचारिणं कृणुते गर्भमन्तः ।
तं रात्रीस्तिस्र उदरे बिभर्ति तं जातं द्रष्टुमभिसंयन्ति देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
acharya upanayamano brahmacharinam krinute garbhamantah |
tam ratristisra udare bibharti tam jatam drashtumabhisamyanti devah ||
verses.en: The teacher, taking [him] in charge (upa-nī), makes the Vedic student an embryo within; he bears him in his belly three nights; the gods gather unto him to see him when born.

verses.sa:
इयं समित्पृथिवी द्यौर्द्वितीयोतान्तरिक्षं समिधा पृणाति ।
ब्रह्मचारी समिधा मेखलया श्रमेण लोकांस्तपसा पिपर्ति ॥
verses.rom:
iyam samitprithivi dyaurdvitiyotantariksham samidha prinati |
brahmachari samidha mekhalaya shramena lokamstapasa piparti ||
verses.en: This piece of fuel [is] earth, sky the second; also the atmosphere he fills with fuel; the Vedic student fills the worlds with fuel, girdle, toil, fervor.

verses.sa:
पूर्वो जातो ब्रह्मणो ब्रह्मचारी घर्मं वसानस्तपसोदतिष्ठत्।
तस्माज्जातं ब्राह्मणं ब्रह्म ज्येष्ठं देवाश्च सर्वे अमृतेन साकम् ॥
verses.rom:
purvo jato brahmano brahmachari gharmam vasanastapasodatishthat|
tasmajjatam brahmanam brahma jyeshtham devashcha sarve amritena sakam ||
verses.en: Prior born of the bráhman, the Vedic student, clothing himself with heat (gharmá), stood up with fervor; from him [was] born the brā́hmaṇa, the chief bráhman, and all the gods, together with immortality (amṛ́ta).

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचार्येति समिधा समिद्धः कार्ष्णं वसानो दीक्षितो दीर्घश्मश्रुः ।
स सद्य एति पूर्वस्मादुत्तरं समुद्रं लोकान्त्संगृभ्य मुहुराचरिक्रत् ॥
verses.rom:
brahmacharyeti samidha samiddhah karshnam vasano dikshito dirghashmashruh |
sa sadya eti purvasmaduttaram samudram lokantsamgribhya muhuracharikrat ||
verses.en: The Vedic student goes kindled with fuel, clothing himself in the black-antelope-skin, consecrated, long-bearded; he goes at once from the eastern to the northern ocean, having grasped the worlds, again and again violently shaping (? ācarikṛ) [them].

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचारी जनयन् ब्रह्मापो लोकं प्रजापतिं परमेष्ठिनं विराजम् ।
गर्भो भूत्वामृतस्य योनाविन्द्रो ह भूत्वासुरांस्ततर्ह ॥
verses.rom:
brahmachari janayan brahmapo lokam prajapatim parameshthinam virajam |
garbho bhutvamritasya yonavindro ha bhutvasuramstatarha ||
verses.en: The Vedic student, generating the bráhman, the waters, the world, Prajāpati, the most exalted one, the virāj, having become an embryo in the womb of immortality; having become Indra, he has shattered (tṛh) the Asuras.

verses.sa:
आचार्यस्ततक्ष नभसी उभे इमे उर्वी गम्भीरे पृथिवीं दिवं च ।
ते रक्षति तपसा ब्रह्मचारी तस्मिन् देवाः संमनसो भवन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
acharyastataksha nabhasi ubhe ime urvi gambhire prithivim divam cha |
te rakshati tapasa brahmachari tasmin devah sammanaso bhavanti ||
verses.en: The teacher fabricated both these envelops (nábhas), the wide, profound, [namely] earth and sky; them the Vedic student defends by fervor; in him the gods become like-minded.

verses.sa:
इमां भूमिं पृथिवीं ब्रह्मचारी भिक्षामा जभार प्रथमो दिवं च ।
ते कृत्वा समिधावुपास्ते तयोरार्पिता भुवनानि विश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
imam bhumim prithivim brahmachari bhikshama jabhara prathamo divam cha |
te kritva samidhavupaste tayorarpita bhuvanani vishva ||
verses.en: This broad (pṛthivī́) earth, and the sky, the Vedic student first brought [as] alms (bhikṣā́); having made them [both] fuel, he worships; in them are set (ā́rpita) all beings.

verses.sa:
अर्वागन्यः परो अन्यो दिवस्पृष्ठाद्गुहा निधी निहितौ ब्राह्मणस्य ।
तौ रक्षति तपसा ब्रह्मचारी तत्केवलं कृणुते ब्रह्म विद्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
arvaganyah paro anyo divasprishthadguha nidhi nihitau brahmanasya |
tau rakshati tapasa brahmachari tatkevalam krinute brahma vidvan ||
verses.en: The one this side, the other beyond, the back of the sky, in secret [are] deposited ni-dhā the two treasures (nidhí) of the brā́hmaṇa; them the Vedic student defends by fervor; the whole of that he, knowing, makes bráhman for himself.

verses.sa:
अर्वागन्य इतो अन्यः पृथिव्या अग्नी समेतो नभसी अन्तरेमे ।
तयोः श्रयन्ते रश्मयोऽधि दृढास्तान् आ तिष्ठति तपसा ब्रह्मचारी ॥
verses.rom:
arvaganya ito anyah prithivya agni sameto nabhasi antareme |
tayoh shrayante rashmayo'dhi dridhastan a tishthati tapasa brahmachari ||
verses.en: The one this side, the other hence, from earth, the two fires come together between these two envelops; upon them are set (çri) the firm rays; these the Vedic student stands upon by fervor.

verses.sa:
अभिक्रन्दन् स्तनयन्न् अरुणः शितिङ्गो बृहच्छेपोऽनु भूमौ जभार ।
ब्रह्मचारी सिञ्चति सानौ रेतः पृथिव्यां तेन जीवन्ति प्रदिशश्चतस्रः ॥
verses.rom:
abhikrandan stanayann arunah shitingo brihachchhepo'nu bhumau jabhara |
brahmachari sinchati sanau retah prithivyam tena jivanti pradishashchatasrah ||
verses.en: Roaring on, thundering, the ruddy white-goer has introduced (? anu-bhṛ) in the earth a great virile member; the Vedic student pours seed upon the surface (sā́nu), on the earth; by that live the four directions.

verses.sa:
अग्नौ सूर्ये चन्द्रमसि मातरिश्वन् ब्रह्मचार्यप्सु समिधमा दधाति ।
तासामर्चींषि पृथगभ्रे चरन्ति तासामाज्यं पुरुषो वर्षमापः ॥
verses.rom:
agnau surye chandramasi matarishvan brahmacharyapsu samidhama dadhati |
tasamarchimshi prithagabhre charanti tasamajyam purusho varshamapah ||
verses.en: In the fire, in the sun, in the moon, in Mātariçvan, in the waters, the Vedic student puts fuel; their gleams (arcís) go about separately in the cloud; their sacrificial butter (ā́jya) is man, rain, waters.

verses.sa:
आचार्यो मृत्युर्वरुणः सोम ओषधयः पयः ।
जीमूता आसन्त्सत्वानस्तैरिदं स्वराभृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
acharyo mrityurvarunah soma oshadhayah payah |
jimuta asantsatvanastairidam svarabhritam ||
verses.en: The teacher [was] death, Varuṇa, Soma, the herbs, milk; the thunder-clouds were warriors; by them [was] this heaven (svàr) brought.

verses.sa:
अमा घृतं कृणुते केवलमाचार्यो भूत्वा वरुणः यद्यदैच्छत्प्रजापतौ।
तद्ब्रह्मचारी प्रायच्छत्स्वान् मित्रो अध्यात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
ama ghritam krinute kevalamacharyo bhutva varunah yadyadaichchhatprajapatau|
tadbrahmachari prayachchhatsvan mitro adhyatmanah ||
verses.en: Varuṇa, having become teacher, makes his own (? amā́) the entire ghee; whatever he sought of Prajāpati, that the Vedic student furnished, a friend (mitrá) from his own self.

verses.sa:
आचार्यो ब्रह्मचारी ब्रह्मचारी प्रजापतिः ।
प्रजापतिर्वि राजति विराडिन्द्रोऽभवद्वशी ॥
verses.rom:
acharyo brahmachari brahmachari prajapatih |
prajapatirvi rajati viradindro'bhavadvashi ||
verses.en: The teacher [is] the Vedic student; the Vedic student [is] Prajāpati; Prajāpati bears rule (vi-rāj); the virā́j became the controlling Indra.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचर्येण तपसा राजा राष्ट्रं वि रक्षति ।
आचार्यो ब्रह्मचर्येण ब्रह्मचारिणमिच्छते ॥
verses.rom:
brahmacharyena tapasa raja rashtram vi rakshati |
acharyo brahmacharyena brahmacharinamichchhate ||
verses.en: By Vedic-studentship, by fervor, a king defends his kingdom; a teacher by Vedic-studentship (brahmacárya) seeks a Vedic student.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचर्येण कन्या युवानं विन्दते पतिम् ।
अनड्वान् ब्रह्मचर्येणाश्वो घासं जिगीषति ॥
verses.rom:
brahmacharyena kanya yuvanam vindate patim |
anadvan brahmacharyenashvo ghasam jigishati ||
verses.en: By Vedic-studentship a girl wins (vid) a young husband; by Vedic-studentship a draft-ox, a horse strives to gain (ji) food.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचर्येण तपसा देवा मृत्युमपाघ्नत ।
इन्द्रो ह ब्रह्मचर्येण देवेभ्यः स्वराभरत् ॥
verses.rom:
brahmacharyena tapasa deva mrityumapaghnata |
indro ha brahmacharyena devebhyah svarabharat ||
verses.en: By Vedic-studentship, by fervor, the gods smote away death; Indra by Vedic-studentship brought heaven (svàr) for the gods.

verses.sa:
ओषधयो भूतभव्यमहोरात्रे वनस्पतिः ।
संवत्सरः सह ऋतुभिस्ते जाता ब्रह्मचारिणः ॥
verses.rom:
oshadhayo bhutabhavyamahoratre vanaspatih |
samvatsarah saha ritubhiste jata brahmacharinah ||
verses.en: The herbs, past and future, day and night, the forest tree, the year together with the seasons—they are born of the Vedic student.

verses.sa:
पार्थिवा दिव्याः पशव आरण्या ग्राम्याश्च ये ।
अपक्षाः पक्षिणश्च ये ते जाता ब्रह्मचारिणः ॥
verses.rom:
parthiva divyah pashava aranya gramyashcha ye |
apakshah pakshinashcha ye te jata brahmacharinah ||
verses.en: The earthly, the heavenly cattle, they of the forest, and they that are of the village, the wingless and they that are winged—they are born of the Vedic student.

verses.sa:
पृथक्सर्वे प्राजापत्याः प्राणान् आत्मसु बिभ्रति ।
तान्त्सर्वान् ब्रह्म रक्षति ब्रह्मचारिण्याभृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
prithaksarve prajapatyah pranan atmasu bibhrati |
tantsarvan brahma rakshati brahmacharinyabhritam ||
verses.en: Individually do all that are of Prajāpati bear breaths in their bodies (ātmán); all these the bráhman defends, brought in the Vedic student.

verses.sa:
देवानामेतत्परिषूतमनभ्यारूढं चरति रोचमानम् ।
तस्माज्जातं ब्राह्मणं ब्रह्म ज्येष्ठं देवाश्च सर्वे अमृतेन साकम् ॥
verses.rom:
devanametatparishutamanabhyarudham charati rochamanam |
tasmajjatam brahmanam brahma jyeshtham devashcha sarve amritena sakam ||
verses.en: That, sent forth (? pariṣūtá) of the gods, not mounted onto, goes about shining; from that [was] born the brā́hmana, the chief bráhman, and all the gods, together with immortality.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचारी ब्रह्म भ्राजद्बिभर्ति तस्मिन् देवा अधि विश्वे समोताः ।
प्राणापानौ जनयन्न् आद्व्यानं वाचं मनो हृदयं ब्रह्म मेधाम् ॥
verses.rom:
brahmachari brahma bhrajadbibharti tasmin deva adhi vishve samotah |
pranapanau janayann advyanam vacham mano hridayam brahma medham ||
verses.en: The Vedic student bears a shining bráhman; in that [are] woven together all the gods; [he] generating breath-and-expiration, then out-breathing (vyāná), speech, mind, heart, bráhman, wisdom.

verses.sa: चक्षुः श्रोत्रं यशो अस्मासु धेह्यन्नं रेतो लोहितमुदरम् ॥
verses.rom: chakshuh shrotram yasho asmasu dhehyannam reto lohitamudaram ||
verses.en: Sight, hearing, glory put thou in us; food, seed, blood (lóhita), belly.

verses.sa:
तानि कल्पन् ब्रह्मचारी सलिलस्य पृष्ठे तपोऽतिष्ठत्तप्यमानः समुद्रे ।
स स्नातो बभ्रुः पिङ्गलः पृथिव्यां बहु रोचते ॥
verses.rom:
tani kalpan brahmachari salilasya prishthe tapo'tishthattapyamanah samudre |
sa snato babhruh pingalah prithivyam bahu rochate ||
verses.en: Shaping (?) these things, the Vedic student stood performing penance (tapas tapya-) on the back of the sea (salilá), in the ocean; he, bathed, brown, ruddy (pin̄galá), shines much on the earth.

verses.sa:
अग्निं ब्रूमो वनस्पतीन् ओषधीरुत वीरुधः ।
इन्द्रं बृहस्पतिं सूर्यं ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
agnim brumo vanaspatin oshadhiruta virudhah |
indram brihaspatim suryam te no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: We address (brū) Agni, the forest trees, the herbs and the plants, Indra, Brihaspati, the sun: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
ब्रूमो राजानं वरुणं मित्रं विष्णुमथो भगम् ।
अंशं विवस्वन्तं ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
brumo rajanam varunam mitram vishnumatho bhagam |
amsham vivasvantam brumaste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: We address king Varuṇa, Mitra, Vishṇu, likewise Bhaga; Aṅça, Vivasvant we address: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
ब्रूमो देवं सवितारं धातारमुत पूषणम् ।
त्वष्टारमग्रियं ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
brumo devam savitaram dhataramuta pushanam |
tvashtaramagriyam brumaste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: We address god Savitar, Dhatar and Pūshan; we address Tvashṭar at the head (agriyá): let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
गन्धर्वाप्सरसो ब्रूमो अश्विना ब्रह्मणस्पतिम् ।
अर्यमा नाम यो देवस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
gandharvapsaraso brumo ashvina brahmanaspatim |
aryama nama yo devaste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: The Gandharvas-and-Apsarases we address, the (two) Açvins, Brahmaṇaspati, the god that is Aryaman by name: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
अहोरात्रे इदं ब्रूमः सूर्याचन्द्रमसावुभा ।
विश्वान् आदित्यान् ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
ahoratre idam brumah suryachandramasavubha |
vishvan adityan brumaste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: Day-and-night now we address, sun-and-moon both; all the Ādityas we address: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
वातं ब्रूमः पर्जन्यमन्तरिक्षमथो दिशः ।
आशाश्च सर्वा ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
vatam brumah parjanyamantarikshamatho dishah |
ashashcha sarva brumaste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: The wind we address, Parjanya, the atmosphere, also the quarters, and all regions we address: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
मुञ्चन्तु मा शपथ्यादहोरात्रे अथो उषाः ।
सोमो मा देवो मुञ्चतु यमाहुश्चन्द्रमा इति ॥
verses.rom:
munchantu ma shapathyadahoratre atho ushah |
somo ma devo munchatu yamahushchandrama iti ||
verses.en: Let day-and-night, likewise dawn, free me from what comes from a curse; let god Soma free me, whom they call the moon.

verses.sa:
पार्थिवा दिव्याः पशव आरण्या उत ये मृगाः ।
शकुन्तान् पक्षिणो ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
parthiva divyah pashava aranya uta ye mrigah |
shakuntan pakshino brumaste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: The earthly, the heavenly cattle, also the beasts (mṛgá) that are of the forest; we address the hawks (çakúnta), the birds (pakṣín): let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
भवाशर्वाविदं ब्रूमो रुद्रं पशुपतिश्च यः ।
इषूर्या एषां संविद्म ता नः सन्तु सदा शिवाः ॥
verses.rom:
bhavasharvavidam brumo rudram pashupatishcha yah |
ishurya esham samvidma ta nah santu sada shivah ||
verses.en: Bhava-and-Çarva now we address, Rudra and him that is lord of cattle; the arrows of them which we well know (saṁ-vid)—let those be ever propitious to us.

verses.sa:
दिवं ब्रूमो नक्षत्राणि भूमिं यक्षाणि पर्वतान् ।
समुद्रा नद्यो वेशन्तास्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
divam brumo nakshatrani bhumim yakshani parvatan |
samudra nadyo veshantaste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: We address the sky, the asterisms, the earth, the yakṣās, the mountains; the oceans, the rivers, the pools—let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
सप्तऋषीन् वा इदं ब्रूमोऽपो देवीः प्रजापतिम् ।
पितॄन् यमश्रेष्ठान् ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
saptarishin va idam brumo'po devih prajapatim |
pitrin yamashreshthan brumaste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: The seven seers now we address, the heavenly waters, Prajāpati; the Fathers with Yama as their chief (çréṣṭha) we address: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
ये देवा दिविषदो अन्तरिक्षसदश्च ये ।
