पृथिव्यां शक्रा ये श्रितास्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
ye deva divishado antarikshasadashcha ye |
prithivyam shakra ye shritaste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: The gods that are seated in the sky, and that are seated in the atmosphere, the mighty ones (çakrá) that are set (çri) on the earth—let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
आदित्या रुद्रा वसवो दिवि देवा अथर्वाणः ।
अङ्गिरसो मनीषिणस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
aditya rudra vasavo divi deva atharvanah |
angiraso manishinaste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: The Ādityas, the Rudras, the Vasus, the gods in heaven, the Atharvans, the An̄girases full of wisdom—let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
यज्ञं ब्रूमो यजमानमृचः सामानि भेषजा ।
यजूंषि होत्रा ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnam brumo yajamanamrichah samani bheshaja |
yajumshi hotra brumaste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: We address the sacrifice, the sacrificer, the verses (ṛ́c), the chants (sā́man), the remedies; the sacred formulas (yā́jus), the invocations we address: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
पञ्च राज्यानि वीरुधां सोमश्रेष्ठानि ब्रूमः ।
दर्भो भङ्गो यवः सहस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
pancha rajyani virudham somashreshthani brumah |
darbho bhango yavah sahaste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: The five kingdoms of plants, having Soma as their chief (çréṣṭha), we address; the darbhá, hemp, barley, sáha—let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
अरायान् ब्रूमो रक्षांसि सर्पान् पुण्यजनान् पितॄन् ।
मृत्यून् एकशतं ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
arayan brumo rakshamsi sarpan punyajanan pitrin |
mrityun ekashatam brumaste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: The niggards we address, the demons, the serpents, the pure-folk, the Fathers; the hundred-and-one deaths we address: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
ऋतून् ब्रूम ऋतुपतीन् आर्तवान् उत हायनान् ।
समाः संवत्सरान् मासांस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
ritun bruma ritupatin artavan uta hayanan |
samah samvatsaran masamste no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: The seasons we address, the lords of the seasons, the year-divisions and the winters, the summers, the years, the months: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
एत देवा दक्षिणतः पश्चात्प्राञ्च उदेत ।
पुरस्तादुत्तराच्छक्रा विश्वे देवाः समेत्य ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
eta deva dakshinatah pashchatprancha udeta |
purastaduttarachchhakra vishve devah sametya te no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: Come, ye gods, from the south; from the west come up eastward; from the east, from the north, mighty, all the gods, coming together: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
विश्वान् देवान् इदं ब्रूमः सत्यसन्धान् ऋतावृधः ।
विश्वाभिः पत्नीभिः सह ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvan devan idam brumah satyasandhan ritavridhah |
vishvabhih patnibhih saha te no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: All the gods now we address, of true agreements, increasers of righteousness, together with all their spouses: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
सर्वान् देवान् इदं ब्रूमः सत्यसन्धान् ऋतावृधः ।
सर्वाभिः पत्नीभिः सह ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
sarvan devan idam brumah satyasandhan ritavridhah |
sarvabhih patnibhih saha te no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: The collective gods now we address, of true agreements, increasers of righteousness, together with their collective spouses: let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
भूतं ब्रूमो भूतपतिं भूतानामुत यो वशी ।
भूतानि सर्वा संगत्य ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
bhutam brumo bhutapatim bhutanamuta yo vashi |
bhutani sarva samgatya te no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: Existence we address, the lord of existences, and who is controller of existences; all existences, assembling—let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
या देवीः पञ्च प्रदिशो ये देवा द्वादश ऋतवः ।
संवत्सरस्य ये दंष्ट्रास्ते नः सन्तु सदा शिवाः ॥
verses.rom:
ya devih pancha pradisho ye deva dvadasha ritavah |
samvatsarasya ye damshtraste nah santu sada shivah ||
verses.en: They that are the five divine directions, that are the twelve divine seasons, that are the fangs of the year—let them be ever propitious to us.

verses.sa:
यन् मातली रथक्रीतममृतं वेद भेषजम् ।
तदिन्द्रो अप्सु प्रावेशयत्तदापो दत्त भेषजम् ॥
verses.rom:
yan matali rathakritamamritam veda bheshajam |
tadindro apsu praveshayattadapo datta bheshajam ||
verses.en: The immortal remedy, chariot-bought, which Mātalī knows—that Indra made enter into the waters; that remedy, O waters, give ye.

verses.sa:
उच्छिष्टे नाम रूपं चोच्छिष्टे लोक आहितः ।
उच्छिष्ट इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च विश्वमन्तः समाहितम् ॥
verses.rom:
uchchhishte nama rupam chochchhishte loka ahitah |
uchchhishta indrashchagnishcha vishvamantah samahitam ||
verses.en: In the remnant [are set] name and form, in the remnant [is] set the world; within the remnant both Indra and Agni, everything is set together.

verses.sa:
उच्छिष्टे द्यावापृथिवी विश्वं भूतं समाहितम् ।
आपः समुद्र उच्छिष्टे चन्द्रमा वात आहितः ॥
verses.rom:
uchchhishte dyavaprithivi vishvam bhutam samahitam |
apah samudra uchchhishte chandrama vata ahitah ||
verses.en: In the remnant heaven-and-earth, all existence is set together; in the remnant the waters, the ocean, the moon, the wind is set.

verses.sa:
सन्न् उच्छिष्टे असंश्चोभौ मृत्युर्वाजः प्रजापतिः ।
लौक्या उच्छिष्ट आयत्ता व्रश्च द्रश्चापि श्रीर्मयि ॥
verses.rom:
sann uchchhishte asamshchobhau mrityurvajah prajapatih |
laukya uchchhishta ayatta vrashcha drashchapi shrirmayi ||
verses.en: In the remnant [are] the being one and the non-being one, both, death, vigor, Prajāpati; they of the world (lāukyá) are supported (ā-yat) on the remnant, both vrá and drá; also fortune (çrī́) in me.

verses.sa:
दृढो दृंह स्थिरो न्यो ब्रह्म विश्वसृजो दश ।
नाभिमिव सर्वतश्चक्रमुच्छिष्टे देवताः श्रिताः ॥
verses.rom:
dridho drimha sthiro nyo brahma vishvasrijo dasha |
nabhimiva sarvatashchakramuchchhishte devatah shritah ||
verses.en: Being fixed, fix thou, being stanch, nyá, the bráhman, the ten all-creators; as the wheel on all sides of the nave, the divinities [are] set (çritá) in the remnant.

verses.sa:
ऋक्साम यजुरुच्छिष्ट उद्गीथः प्रस्तुतं स्तुतम् ।
हिङ्कार उच्छिष्टे स्वरः साम्नो मेडिश्च तन् मयि ॥
verses.rom:
riksama yajuruchchhishta udgithah prastutam stutam |
hinkara uchchhishte svarah samno medishcha tan mayi ||
verses.en: The verse (ṛ́c), the chant (sā́man), the formula (yájus) [are] in the remnant, [also] the song (udgīthá), the introductory praise (prástuta),the praise (stutá); the sound hing [is] in the remnant, the tone (svára), and the ring (? meḍí) of the chant; that in me.

verses.sa:
ऐन्द्राग्नं पावमानं महानाम्नीर्महाव्रतम् ।
उच्छिष्टे यज्ञस्याङ्गान्यन्तर्गर्भ इव मातरि ॥
verses.rom:
aindragnam pavamanam mahanamnirmahavratam |
uchchhishte yajnasyanganyantargarbha iva matari ||
verses.en: That relating to Indra-and-Agni, that to the purifying [Soma] (pāvamāná), the great-named ones (f., mahā́nāmnīs), the great ceremony (makāvratá)—within the remnant are [all] the members of the sacrifice, like an embryo within a mother.

verses.sa:
राजसूयं वाजपेयमग्निष्टोमस्तदध्वरः ।
अर्काश्वमेधावुच्छिष्टे जीवबर्हिर्मदिन्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
rajasuyam vajapeyamagnishtomastadadhvarah |
arkashvamedhavuchchhishte jivabarhirmadintamah ||
verses.en: The rājasūya (royal consecration), the vājapéya (vigor-drinking), the agniṣṭomá (fire-praise), then the sacrifice (adhvará), the arká and açvamedhá (horse-sacrifice) [are] in the remnant, the one having a living barhís, most intoxicating.

verses.sa:
अग्न्याधेयमथो दीक्षा कामप्रश्छन्दसा सह ।
उत्सन्ना यज्ञाः सत्राण्युच्छिष्टेऽधि समाहिताः ॥
verses.rom:
agnyadheyamatho diksha kamaprashchhandasa saha |
utsanna yajnah satranyuchchhishte'dhi samahitah ||
verses.en: The establishing of a fire, also the consecration, the desire-fulfiller, together with the meter (chándas); the removed (? útsanna) sacrifices, the sacrificial sessions (sattrá), are set together in the remnant.

verses.sa:
अग्निहोत्रं च श्रद्धा च वषट्कारो व्रतं तपः ।
दक्षिणेष्टं पूर्तं चोच्छिष्टेऽधि समाहिताः ॥
verses.rom:
agnihotram cha shraddha cha vashatkaro vratam tapah |
dakshineshtam purtam chochchhishte'dhi samahitah ||
verses.en: Both the fire-offering (agnihotrá) and faith, the váshaṭ-exclamation, the vow (vratá), penance, the sacrificial gift (dákṣiṇā), what is offered (iṣṭá) and what is bestowed (pūrtá)—are set together in the remnant.

verses.sa:
एकरात्रो द्विरात्रः सद्यःक्रीः प्रक्रीरुक्थ्यः ।
ओतं निहितमुच्छिष्टे यज्ञस्याणूनि विद्यया ॥
verses.rom:
ekaratro dviratrah sadyahkrih prakrirukthyah |
otam nihitamuchchhishte yajnasyanuni vidyaya ||
verses.en: The one-night [sacrifice], the two-night, the same-day-purchase (sadyaḥkrī́), the purchasable (? prakrī́), the praiseworthy (ukthyà)—[it] is woven, deposited, in the remnant; the minute things of the sacrifice, by wisdom.

verses.sa:
चतूरात्रः पञ्चरात्रः षड्रात्रश्चोभयः सह ।
षोडशी सप्तरात्रश्चोच्छिष्टाज्जज्ञिरे सर्वे ये यज्ञा अमृते हिताः ॥
verses.rom:
chaturatrah pancharatrah shadratrashchobhayah saha |
shodashi saptaratrashchochchhishtajjajnire sarve ye yajna amrite hitah ||
verses.en: The four-night [sacrifice], the five-night, and the six-night, of both kinds, together, the one of sixteen (ṣoḍaçín), and the seven-night—from the remnant were born all the sacrifices that are put in immortality.

verses.sa:
प्रतीहारो निधनं विश्वजिच्चाभिजिच्च यः ।
साह्नातिरात्रावुच्छिष्टे द्वादशाहोऽपि तन् मयि ॥
verses.rom:
pratiharo nidhanam vishvajichchabhijichcha yah |
sahnatiratravuchchhishte dvadashaho'pi tan mayi ||
verses.en: The response (pratīhārá), the conclusion (nidhánd), both the all-conquering and the on-conquering (abhijít) one, the same-day and overnight ones [are] in the remnant, the twelve-day one: also that in me.

verses.sa:
सूनृता संनतिः क्षेमः स्वधोर्जामृतं सहः ।
उच्छिष्टे सर्वे प्रत्यञ्चः कामाः कामेन तातृपुः ॥
verses.rom:
sunrita samnatih kshemah svadhorjamritam sahah |
uchchhishte sarve pratyanchah kamah kamena tatripuh ||
verses.en: Pleasantness, compliance (sáṁnati), comfort (kṣéma), custom (? svadhā́), refreshment, immortality, power—in the remnant all occurring (pratyáñc) desires are satisfied with desire.

verses.sa:
नव भूमीः समुद्रा उच्छिष्टेऽधि श्रिता दिवः ।
आ सूर्यो भात्युच्छिष्टेऽहोरात्रे अपि तन् मयि ॥
verses.rom:
nava bhumih samudra uchchhishte'dhi shrita divah |
a suryo bhatyuchchhishte'horatre api tan mayi ||
verses.en: The nine earths, oceans, skies, are set (çritá) in the remnant; the sun shines in the remnant; day-and-night: also that in me.

verses.sa:
उपहव्यं विषूवन्तं ये च यज्ञा गुहा हिताः ।
बिभर्ति भर्ता विश्वस्योच्छिष्टो जनितुः पिता ॥
verses.rom:
upahavyam vishuvantam ye cha yajna guha hitah |
bibharti bharta vishvasyochchhishto janituh pita ||
verses.en: The added oblation (upahávya), the dividing [day], and the sacrifices that are put in secret, the remnant bears, bearer of all, father of the generator.

verses.sa:
पिता जनितुरुच्छिष्टोऽसोः पौत्रः पितामहः ।
स क्षियति विश्वस्येशानो वृषा भूम्यामतिघ्न्यः ॥
verses.rom:
pita janituruchchhishto'soh pautrah pitamahah |
sa kshiyati vishvasyeshano vrisha bhumyamatighnyah ||
verses.en: The remnant, father of the generator, of breath (ásu) the grandson, grandfather—he dwells, ruler of all, an overpowering (? atighnyà) bull upon the earth.

verses.sa:
ऋतं सत्यं तपो राष्ट्रं श्रमो धर्मश्च कर्म च ।
भूतं भविष्यदुच्छिष्टे वीर्यं लक्ष्मीर्बलं बले ॥
verses.rom:
ritam satyam tapo rashtram shramo dharmashcha karma cha |
bhutam bhavishyaduchchhishte viryam lakshmirbalam bale ||
verses.en: Righteousness, truth, penance, kingship, toil, and virtue (dhárma) and deed (kárman), being (bhūtá), what will be, [is] in the remnant; heroism, fortune (lakṣmī́), strength in strength.

verses.sa:
समृद्धिरोज आकूतिः क्षत्रं राष्ट्रं षडुर्व्यः ।
संवत्सरोऽध्युच्छिष्ट इडा प्रैषा ग्रहा हविः ॥
verses.rom:
samriddhiroja akutih kshatram rashtram shadurvyah |
samvatsaro'dhyuchchhishta ida praisha graha havih ||
verses.en: Success, force, design, dominion, kingship, the six wide [quarters], the year [is] in the remnant, íḍā, the orders (prāiṣá), the dips (gráha), the oblation.

verses.sa:
चतुर्होतार आप्रियश्चातुर्मास्यानि नीविदः ।
उच्छिष्टे यज्ञा होत्राः पशुबन्धास्तदिष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
chaturhotara apriyashchaturmasyani nividah |
uchchhishte yajna hotrah pashubandhastadishtayah ||
verses.en: The four-priest (cátur-hotṛ) [sacrifices], the āprī́s, the seasonal [oblations], the nivíds—in the remnant [are] the sacrifices, the invocations, the victim-offerings (paçubandhá), then the offerings (íṣṭi).

verses.sa:
अर्धमासाश्च मासाश्चार्तवा ऋतुभिः सह ।
उच्छिष्टे घोषिणीराप स्तनयित्नुः श्रुतिर्मही ॥
verses.rom:
ardhamasashcha masashchartava ritubhih saha |
uchchhishte ghoshinirapa stanayitnuh shrutirmahi ||
verses.en: Both the half-months and the months, the year-divisions (ārtavá) with the seasons; in the remnant [are] the noisy waters, the thunder, the great sound (? çrúti).

verses.sa:
शर्कराः सिकता अश्मान ओषधयो वीरुधस्तृणा ।
अभ्राणि विद्युतो वर्षमुच्छिष्टे संश्रिता श्रिता ॥
verses.rom:
sharkarah sikata ashmana oshadhayo virudhastrina |
abhrani vidyuto varshamuchchhishte samshrita shrita ||
verses.en: Pebbles, gravel, stones, herbs, plants, grasses, clouds, lightnings, rain—in the remnant [are they] set together, set.

verses.sa:
राद्धिः प्राप्तिः समाप्तिर्व्याप्तिर्मह एधतुः ।
अत्याप्तिरुच्छिष्टे भूतिश्चाहिता निहिता हिता ॥
verses.rom:
raddhih praptih samaptirvyaptirmaha edhatuh |
atyaptiruchchhishte bhutishchahita nihita hita ||
verses.en: Success (rā́ddhi), attainment, obtainment, permeation, greatness, prosperity edhatú—in the remnant over-attainment and growth (bhū́ti) [is] put in, put down, put.

verses.sa:
यच्च प्राणति प्राणेन यच्च पश्यति चक्षुषा ।
उच्छिष्टाज्जज्ञिरे सर्वे दिवि देवा दिविश्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
yachcha pranati pranena yachcha pashyati chakshusha |
uchchhishtajjajnire sarve divi deva divishritah ||
verses.en: Both what breathes with breath and what sees with sight: from the remnant were born all the gods in heaven, heaven-resorters.

verses.sa:
ऋचः सामानि छन्दांसि पुराणं यजुषा सह ।
उच्छिष्टाज्जज्ञिरे सर्वे दिवि देवा दिविश्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
richah samani chhandamsi puranam yajusha saha |
uchchhishtajjajnire sarve divi deva divishritah ||
verses.en: The verses (ṛ́c), the chants, the meters, the ancient (purāṇá), together with the formula (yájus): from the remnant were born etc. etc.

verses.sa:
प्राणापानौ चक्षुः श्रोत्रमक्षितिश्च क्षितिश्च या ।
उच्छिष्टाज्जज्ञिरे सर्वे दिवि देवा दिविश्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
pranapanau chakshuh shrotramakshitishcha kshitishcha ya |
uchchhishtajjajnire sarve divi deva divishritah ||
verses.en: Breath-and-expiration, sight, hearing, indestructibleness and destruction: from the remnant etc. etc.

verses.sa:
आनन्दा मोदाः प्रमुदोऽभीमोदमुदश्च ये ।
उच्छिष्टाज्जज्ञिरे सर्वे दिवि देवा दिविश्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
ananda modah pramudo'bhimodamudashcha ye |
uchchhishtajjajnire sarve divi deva divishritah ||
verses.en: Delights, joys, enjoyments, and they that enjoy enjoyments—from the remnant etc. etc.

verses.sa:
देवाः पितरो मनुष्या गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्च ये ।
उच्छिष्टाज्जज्ञिरे सर्वे दिवि देवा दिविश्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
devah pitaro manushya gandharvapsarasashcha ye |
uchchhishtajjajnire sarve divi deva divishritah ||
verses.en: The gods, the Fathers, human beings, and they that are Gandharvas-and-Apsarases: from the remnant etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यन् मन्युर्जायामावहत्संकल्पस्य गृहादधि ।
क आसं जन्याः के वराः क उ ज्येष्ठवरोऽभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
yan manyurjayamavahatsamkalpasya grihadadhi |
ka asam janyah ke varah ka u jyeshthavaro'bhavat ||
verses.en: When fury (manyú) brought his wife away from the house of contrivance (saṁkalpá), who were the groomsmen (jánya)? who the wooers (vará)? who also was chief wooer?

verses.sa:
तपश्चैवास्तां कर्म चान्तर्महत्यर्णवे ।
त आसं जन्यास्ते वरा ब्रह्म ज्येष्ठवरोऽभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
tapashchaivastam karma chantarmahatyarnave |
ta asam janyaste vara brahma jyeshthavaro'bhavat ||
verses.en: Penance and also action were within the great sea (arṇavá); those were the groomsmen, those the wooers; the bráhman was chief wooer.

verses.sa:
दश साकमजायन्त देवा देवेभ्यः पुरा ।
यो वै तान् विद्यात्प्रत्यक्षं स वा अद्य महद्वदेत् ॥
verses.rom:
dasha sakamajayanta deva devebhyah pura |
yo vai tan vidyatpratyaksham sa va adya mahadvadet ||
verses.en: Ten gods were born together from gods of old; whoever may know them plainly, he verily may talk big to-day.

verses.sa:
प्राणापानौ चक्षुः श्रोत्रमक्षितिश्च क्षितिश्च या ।
व्यानोदानौ वाङ्मनस्ते वा आकूतिमावहन् ॥
verses.rom:
pranapanau chakshuh shrotramakshitishcha kshitishcha ya |
vyanodanau vanmanaste va akutimavahan ||
verses.en: Breath-and-expiration, sight, hearing, indestructibleness and destruction, out-breathing and up-breathing, speech, mind—they verily brought design (ā́kūti).

verses.sa:
अजाता आसन्न् ऋतवोऽथो धाता बृहस्पतिः ।
इन्द्राग्नी अश्विना तर्हि कं ते ज्येष्ठमुपासत ॥
verses.rom:
ajata asann ritavo'tho dhata brihaspatih |
indragni ashvina tarhi kam te jyeshthamupasata ||
verses.en: Unborn were the seasons, likewise Dhātar, Brihaspati, Indra-andAgni, the two Açvins, at that time: whom did they worship (upa-ās) [as] chief?

verses.sa:
तपश्चैवास्तां कर्म चान्तर्महत्यर्णवे ।
तपो ह जज्ञे कर्मणस्तत्ते ज्येष्ठमुपासत ॥
verses.rom:
tapashchaivastam karma chantarmahatyarnave |
tapo ha jajne karmanastatte jyeshthamupasata ||
verses.en: Both penance, namely, and action were within the great sea; penance was born from action; that did they worship as chief.

verses.sa:
येत आसीद्भूमिः पूर्वा यामद्धातय इद्विदुः ।
यो वै तां विद्यान् नामथा स मन्येत पुराणवित् ॥
verses.rom:
yeta asidbhumih purva yamaddhataya idviduh |
yo vai tam vidyan namatha sa manyeta puranavit ||
verses.en: The earth that was previous to this one (itás), which the sages (addhātí) indeed knew—whoever may know that by name, he may think himself knowing in ancient things.

verses.sa:
कुत इन्द्रः कुतः सोमः कुतो अग्निरजायत ।
कुतस्त्वष्टा समभवत्कुतो धाताजायत ॥
verses.rom:
kuta indrah kutah somah kuto agnirajayata |
kutastvashta samabhavatkuto dhatajayata ||
verses.en: Whence was Indra, whence Soma, whence Agni born? whence did Tvashṭar come into being? whence was Dhātar born?

verses.sa:
इन्द्रादिन्द्रः सोमात्सोमो अग्नेरग्निरजायत ।
त्वष्टा ह जज्ञे त्वष्टुर्धातुर्धाताजायत ॥
verses.rom:
indradindrah somatsomo agneragnirajayata |
tvashta ha jajne tvashturdhaturdhatajayata ||
verses.en: From Indra Indra, from Soma Soma, from Agni Agni was born; Tvashṭar was born from Tvashṭar; from Dhātar Dhātar was born.

verses.sa:
ये त आसन् दश जाता देवा देवेभ्यः पुरा ।
पुत्रेभ्यो लोकं दत्त्वा कस्मिंस्ते लोक आसते ॥
verses.rom:
ye ta asan dasha jata deva devebhyah pura |
putrebhyo lokam dattva kasmimste loka asate ||
verses.en: The ten gods that were of old, born from gods—having given the world to [their] sons, in what world sit they?

verses.sa:
यदा केशान् अस्थि स्नाव मांसं मज्जानमाभरत्।
शरीरं कृत्वा पादवत्कं लोकमनु प्राविशत् ॥
verses.rom:
yada keshan asthi snava mamsam majjanamabharat|
shariram kritva padavatkam lokamanu pravishat ||
verses.en: When he brought hair, bone, sinew, flesh, marrow, having made a body with feet, what world did he afterward enter?

verses.sa:
कुतः केशान् कुतः स्नाव कुतो अस्थीन्याभरत्।
अङ्गा पर्वाणि मज्जानं को मांसं कुत आभरत् ॥
verses.rom:
kutah keshan kutah snava kuto asthinyabharat|
anga parvani majjanam ko mamsam kuta abharat ||
verses.en: Whence brought he the hair, whence the sinew, whence the bones? the limbs, the joints, the marrow, the flesh who brought from whence?

verses.sa:
संसिचो नाम ते देवा ये संभारान्त्समभरन् ।
सर्वं संसिच्य मर्त्यं देवाः पुरुषमाविशन् ॥
verses.rom:
samsicho nama te deva ye sambharantsamabharan |
sarvam samsichya martyam devah purushamavishan ||
verses.en: Pourers-together namely are those gods who brought together the bringings-together; having poured together the whole mortal, the gods entered man.

verses.sa:
ऊरू पादावष्ठीवन्तौ शिरो हस्तावथो मुखम् ।
पृष्टीर्बर्जह्ये पार्श्वे कस्तत्समदधादृषिः ॥
verses.rom:
uru padavashthivantau shiro hastavatho mukham |
prishtirbarjahye parshve kastatsamadadhadrishih ||
verses.en: Thighs, feet, knee-joints, head, hands, also face, ribs, nipples (? barjahyà), sides: what seer put that together?

verses.sa:
शिरो हस्तावथो मुखं जिह्वां ग्रीवाश्च कीकसाः ।
त्वचा प्रावृत्य सर्वं तत्संधा समदधान् मही ॥
verses.rom:
shiro hastavatho mukham jihvam grivashcha kikasah |
tvacha pravritya sarvam tatsamdha samadadhan mahi ||
verses.en: Head, hands, also face, tongue and neck, vertebræ—all that, having enveloped with skin, the great putting-together put together.

verses.sa:
यत्तच्छरीरमशयत्संधया संहितं महत्।
येनेदमद्य रोचते को अस्मिन् वर्णमाभरत् ॥
verses.rom:
yattachchhariramashayatsamdhaya samhitam mahat|
yenedamadya rochate ko asmin varnamabharat ||
verses.en: The great body which lay there, put together by the putting-together—who brought into it the color with which it shines (ruc) here today?

verses.sa:
सर्वे देवा उपाशिक्षन् तदजानाद्वधूः सती ।
ईशा वशस्य या जाया सास्मिन् वर्णमाभरत् ॥
verses.rom:
sarve deva upashikshan tadajanadvadhuh sati |
isha vashasya ya jaya sasmin varnamabharat ||
verses.en: All the gods assisted (? upa-çikṣ); that she who was a woman knew; she who was wife of control (? váça), mistress (īçā́), brought color into it.

verses.sa:
यदा त्वष्टा व्यतृणत्पिता त्वष्टुर्य उत्तरः ।
गृहं कृत्वा मर्त्यं देवाः पुरुषमाविशन् ॥
verses.rom:
yada tvashta vyatrinatpita tvashturya uttarah |
griham kritva martyam devah purushamavishan ||
verses.en: When Tvashṭar bored through [him?] who [was] the superior father of Tvashṭar, having made the mortal a house, the gods entered into man.

verses.sa:
स्वप्नो वै तन्द्रीर्निर्ऋतिः पाप्मानो नाम देवताः ।
जरा खालत्यं पालित्यं शरीरमनु प्राविशन् ॥
verses.rom:
svapno vai tandrirnirritih papmano nama devatah |
jara khalatyam palityam shariramanu pravishan ||
verses.en: Sleep, weariness, misery (nírṛti), the deities named evils, old age, baldness, hoariness, entered the body afterward (ánu).

verses.sa:
स्तेयं दुष्कृतं वृजिनं सत्यं यज्ञो यशो बृहत्।
बलं च क्षत्रमोजश्च शरीरमनु प्राविशन् ॥
verses.rom:
steyam dushkritam vrijinam satyam yajno yasho brihat|
balam cha kshatramojashcha shariramanu pravishan ||
verses.en: Theft, ill-doing, wrong, truth, sacrifice, great glory, both strength, dominion, and force, entered the body afterward.

verses.sa:
भूतिश्च वा अभूतिश्च रातयोऽरातयश्च याः ।
क्षुधश्च सर्वास्तृष्णाश्च शरीरमनु प्राविशन् ॥
verses.rom:
bhutishcha va abhutishcha ratayo'ratayashcha yah |
kshudhashcha sarvastrishnashcha shariramanu pravishan ||
verses.en: Both growth (bhū́ti) and diminution, generosities and niggardlinesses, both hungerings and all thirstings, entered the body afterward.

verses.sa:
निन्दाश्च वा अनिन्दाश्च यच्च हन्तेति नेति च ।
शरीरं श्रद्धा दक्षिणाश्रद्धा चानु प्राविशन् ॥
verses.rom:
nindashcha va anindashcha yachcha hanteti neti cha |
shariram shraddha dakshinashraddha chanu pravishan ||
verses.en: Both revilings and non-revilings, both what [says] "come on" (hánta) and "no," faith, the sacrificial fee, and non-faith, entered the body afterward.

verses.sa:
विद्याश्च वा अविद्याश्च यच्चान्यदुपदेश्यम् ।
शरीरं ब्रह्म प्राविशदृचः सामाथो यजुः ॥
verses.rom:
vidyashcha va avidyashcha yachchanyadupadeshyam |
shariram brahma pravishadrichah samatho yajuh ||
verses.en: Both knowledges and ignorances, and what else is to be taught (upa-diç); the bráhman entered the body; the verses, the chant, also the formula.

verses.sa:
आनन्दा मोदाः प्रमुदोऽभीमोदमुदश्च ये ।
हसो नरिष्टा नृत्तानि शरीरमनु प्राविशन् ॥
verses.rom:
ananda modah pramudo'bhimodamudashcha ye |
haso narishta nrittani shariramanu pravishan ||
verses.en: Delights, joys, enjoyments, and they that enjoy enjoyments, laughter, sport, dances, entered the body afterward.

verses.sa:
आलापाश्च प्रलापाश्चाभीलापलपश्च ये ।
शरीरं सर्वे प्राविशन्न् आयुजः प्रयुजो युजः ॥
verses.rom:
alapashcha pralapashchabhilapalapashcha ye |
shariram sarve pravishann ayujah prayujo yujah ||
verses.en: Both appeals (ālāpá) and pratings (pralāpá), and they who utter (-lap) addresses (abhīlāpa-)—all entered the body, joiners-on (āyúj), joiners-forth (prayúj), joiners.

verses.sa:
प्राणापानौ चक्षुः श्रोत्रमक्षितिश्च क्षितिश्च या ।
व्यानोदानौ वाङ्मनः शरीरेण त ईयन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
pranapanau chakshuh shrotramakshitishcha kshitishcha ya |
vyanodanau vanmanah sharirena ta iyante ||
verses.en: Breath-and-expiration, sight, hearing, indestructibleness and destruction, out-breathing and up-breathing, speech, mind—they go about (īja-) with the body.

verses.sa:
आशिषश्च प्रशिषश्च संशिषो विशिषश्च याः ।
चित्तानि सर्वे संकल्पाः शरीरमनु प्राविशन् ॥
verses.rom:
ashishashcha prashishashcha samshisho vishishashcha yah |
chittani sarve samkalpah shariramanu pravishan ||
verses.en: Both blessings (āçís) and precepts (praçís), demands (saṁçís) and explanations (viçís), thoughts, all devisings, entered the body afterward.

verses.sa:
आस्तेयीश्च वास्तेयीश्च त्वरणाः कृपणाश्च याः ।
गुह्याः शुक्रा स्थूला अपस्ता बीभत्सावसादयन् ॥
verses.rom:
asteyishcha vasteyishcha tvaranah kripanashcha yah |
guhyah shukra sthula apasta bibhatsavasadayan ||
verses.en: Both those of the blood and those of the bladder, the hasting and those that are pitiable, the secret, the clear, the thick waters—those they caused to settle in the repugnant one.

verses.sa:
अस्थि कृत्वा समिधं तदष्टापो असादयन् ।
रेतः कृत्वाज्यं देवाः पुरुषमाविशन् ॥
verses.rom:
asthi kritva samidham tadashtapo asadayan |
retah kritvajyam devah purushamavishan ||
verses.en: Having made bone [their] fuel, then they caused eight waters to settle; having made seed [their] sacrificial butter, the gods entered man.

verses.sa:
या आपो याश्च देवता या विराड्ब्रह्मणा सह ।
शरीरं ब्रह्म प्राविशच्छरीरेऽधि प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.rom:
ya apo yashcha devata ya viradbrahmana saha |
shariram brahma pravishachchharire'dhi prajapatih ||
verses.en: What waters [there are], and what deities, what virā́j, with bráhman; bráhman entered the body; on (ádhi) the body [is] Prajāpati.

verses.sa:
सूर्यश्चक्षुर्वातः प्राणं पुरुषस्य वि भेजिरे ।
अथास्येतरमात्मानं देवाः प्रायच्छन्न् अग्नये ॥
verses.rom:
suryashchakshurvatah pranam purushasya vi bhejire |
athasyetaramatmanam devah prayachchhann agnaye ||
verses.en: The sun, the wind, shared [respectively] the eye, the breath of man; then his other self the gods bestowed (pra-yam) on Agni.

verses.sa:
तस्माद्वै विद्वान् पुरुषमिदं ब्रह्मेति मन्यते ।
सर्वा ह्यस्मिन् देवता गावो गोष्ठ इवासते ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadvai vidvan purushamidam brahmeti manyate |
sarva hyasmin devata gavo goshtha ivasate ||
verses.en: Therefore, indeed, one who knows man púruṣa thinks "this is bráhman"; for all deities are seated in him, as cows in a cow-stall.

verses.sa:
प्रथमेन प्रमारेण त्रेधा विष्वङ्वि गच्छति ।
अद एकेन गच्छत्यद एकेन गच्छतीहैकेन नि षेवते ॥
verses.rom:
prathamena pramarena tredha vishvanvi gachchhati |
ada ekena gachchhatyada ekena gachchhatihaikena ni shevate ||
verses.en: By the first dying, it goes apart dividing threefold: yonder goes it with one [part]; yonder goes it with one; here with one it dwells (? ni-sev).

verses.sa:
अप्सु स्तीमासु वृद्धासु शरीरमन्तरा हितम् ।
तस्मिं छवोऽध्यन्तरा तस्माच्छवोऽध्युच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
apsu stimasu vriddhasu shariramantara hitam |
tasmim chhavo'dhyantara tasmachchhavo'dhyuchyate ||
verses.en: Within waters that are sluggish (? stīmá), old, is the body placed; within that is might (? çáva, çávas ?); thence is it called might.

verses.sa:
ये बाहवो या इषवो धन्वनां वीर्याणि च ।
असीन् परशून् आयुधं चित्ताकूतं च यद्धृदि ।
सर्वं तदर्बुदे त्वममित्रेभ्यो दृशे कुरूदारांश्च प्र दर्शय ॥
verses.rom:
ye bahavo ya ishavo dhanvanam viryani cha |
asin parashun ayudham chittakutam cha yaddhridi |
sarvam tadarbude tvamamitrebhyo drishe kurudaramshcha pra darshaya ||
verses.en: What arms (bāhú) [there are], what arrows, and the powers (vīryà) of bows, swords (así), axes (paraçú), weapon, and what thought-and-design in the heart—all that, O Arbudi, do thou make our enemies to see; and do thou show forth specters (udārá).

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठत सं नह्यध्वं मित्रा देवजना यूयम् ।
संदृष्टा गुप्ता वः सन्तु या नो मित्राण्यर्बुदे ॥
verses.rom:
uttishthata sam nahyadhvam mitra devajana yuyam |
samdrishta gupta vah santu ya no mitranyarbude ||
verses.en: Stand up, equip ye yourselves (sam-nah), O friends, god-folk; beheld, concealed of you be [those] who are our friends, O Arbudi.

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठतमा रभेतामादानसंदानाभ्याम् ।
अमित्राणां सेना अभि धत्तमर्बुदे ॥
verses.rom:
uttishthatama rabhetamadanasamdanabhyam |
amitranam sena abhi dhattamarbude ||
verses.en: Stand ye (two) up, take ye hold; with tying up, with tying together, gird ye the armies of our enemies, O Arbudi.

verses.sa:
अर्बुदिर्नाम यो देव ईशानश्च न्यर्बुदिः ।
याभ्यामन्तरिक्षमावृतमियं च पृथिवी मही ।
ताभ्यामिन्द्रमेदिभ्यामहं जितमन्वेमि सेनया ॥
verses.rom:
arbudirnama yo deva ishanashcha nyarbudih |
yabhyamantarikshamavritamiyam cha prithivi mahi |
tabhyamindramedibhyamaham jitamanvemi senaya ||
verses.en: The God that is Arbudi by name, and the lord (ī́çāna) Nyarbudi, by whom the atmosphere is involved (ā-vṛ), and this great earth—by those (two) who are allied with Indra, I go after what is conquered with an army.

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठ त्वं देवजनार्बुदे सेनया सह ।
भञ्जन्न् अमित्राणां सेनां भोगेभिः परि वारय ॥
verses.rom:
uttishtha tvam devajanarbude senaya saha |
bhanjann amitranam senam bhogebhih pari varaya ||
verses.en: Stand thou up, O god-folk, Arbudi, with the army; breaking (bhañj) the army of our enemies, envelop it with [thy] coils (bhogá).

verses.sa:
सप्त जातान् न्यर्बुद उदाराणां समीक्षयन् ।
तेभिष्ट्वमाज्ये हुते सर्वैरुत्तिष्ठ सेनया ॥
verses.rom:
sapta jatan nyarbuda udaranam samikshayan |
tebhishtvamajye hute sarvairuttishtha senaya ||
verses.en: Presenting to view, O Nyarbudi, the seven kinds of specters, with them all do thou stand up, when the butter is offered, with the army.

verses.sa:
प्रतिघ्नानाश्रुमुखी कृधुकर्णी च क्रोशतु ।
विकेशी पुरुषे हते रदिते अर्बुदे तव ॥
verses.rom:
pratighnanashrumukhi kridhukarni cha kroshatu |
vikeshi purushe hate radite arbude tava ||
verses.en: Smiting herself, tear-faced, and crop-eared (?), let her yell, with disheveled hair, when the man is slain, bitten (? rad), O Arbudi, of thee.

verses.sa:
संकर्षन्ती करूकरं मनसा पुत्रमिच्छन्ती ।
पतिं भ्रातरमात्स्वान् रदिते अर्बुदे तव ॥
verses.rom:
samkarshanti karukaram manasa putramichchhanti |
patim bhrataramatsvan radite arbude tava ||
verses.en: Drawing in her karū́kara, seeking with her mind her son, husband, brother, also her people (svá)—in case of thy bite, O Arbudi.

verses.sa:
अलिक्लवा जाष्कमदा गृध्राः श्येनाः पतत्रिणः ।
ध्वाङ्क्षाः शकुनयस्तृप्यन्त्वमित्रेषु समीक्षयन् रदिते अर्बुदे तव ॥
verses.rom:
aliklava jashkamada gridhrah shyenah patatrinah |
dhvankshah shakunayastripyantvamitreshu samikshayan radite arbude tava ||
verses.en: Let the buzzards, jāṣkamadás, vultures, falcons, winged ones, let the crows, the birds (çakúni), satisfy themselves—exhibiting among the enemies—in case of thy bite, O Arbudi.

verses.sa:
अथो सर्वं श्वापदं मक्षिका तृप्यतु क्रिमिः ।
पौरुषेयेऽधि कुणपे रदिते अर्बुदे तव ॥
verses.rom:
atho sarvam shvapadam makshika tripyatu krimih |
paurusheye'dhi kunape radite arbude tava ||
verses.en: Then let all wild beasts, let the fly, let the worm satisfy itself upon the carrion of men, bitten, O Arbudi, of thee.

verses.sa:
आ गृह्णीतं सं बृहतं प्राणापानान् न्यर्बुदे ।
निवाशा घोषाः सं यन्त्वमित्रेषु समीक्षयन् रदिते अर्बुदे तव ॥
verses.rom:
a grihnitam sam brihatam pranapanan nyarbude |
nivasha ghoshah sam yantvamitreshu samikshayan radite arbude tava ||
verses.en: Take ye (two) hold, tear out (sam-bṛh) [their] breath-and-expiration, O Nyarbudi; let groaning (? nivāçá) noises assemble—exhibiting among the enemies—in case of thy bite, O Arbudi.

verses.sa:
उद्वेपय सं विजन्तां भियामित्रान्त्सं सृज ।
उरुग्राहैर्बाह्वङ्कैर्विध्यामित्रान् न्यर्बुदे ॥
verses.rom:
udvepaya sam vijantam bhiyamitrantsam srija |
urugrahairbahvankairvidhyamitran nyarbude ||
verses.en: Make thou [them] tremble; let them quake together; unite our enemies with fear; with broad-gripping arm-hooks pierce thou our enemies, O Nyarbudi.

verses.sa:
मुह्यन्त्वेषां बाहवश्चित्ताकूतं च यद्धृदि ।
मैषामुच्छेषि किं चन रदिते अर्बुदे तव ॥
verses.rom:
muhyantvesham bahavashchittakutam cha yaddhridi |
maishamuchchheshi kim chana radite arbude tava ||
verses.en: Let their arms be confounded, and what thought-and-design is in their heart; let not anything of them be left—in case of thy bite, O Arbudi.

verses.sa:
प्रतिघ्नानाः सं धावन्तूरः पटौरावाघ्नानाः ।
अघारिणीर्विकेश्यो रुदत्यः पुरुषे हते रदिते अर्बुदे तव ॥
verses.rom:
pratighnanah sam dhavanturah patauravaghnanah |
agharinirvikeshyo rudatyah purushe hate radite arbude tava ||
verses.en: Smiting themselves let them (f.) run together, smiting on the breast, the thighs (? paṭāurá), not anointing, with disheveled hair, wailing when the man is slain, bitten, O Arbudi, of thee.

verses.sa:
श्वन्वतीरप्सरसो रूपका उतार्बुदे ।
अन्तःपात्रे रेरिहतीं रिशां दुर्णिहितैषिणीम् ।
सर्वास्ता अर्बुदे त्वममित्रेभ्यो दृशे कुरूदारांश्च प्र दर्शय ॥
verses.rom:
shvanvatirapsaraso rupaka utarbude |
antahpatre rerihatim risham durnihitaishinim |
sarvasta arbude tvamamitrebhyo drishe kurudaramshcha pra darshaya ||
verses.en: Dog-accompanied Apsarases, she-jackals (? rū́pakā) also, O Arbudi, the riçā́, licking much in the inner vessel, seeking what is ill-deposited—all these (f.), O Arbudi, do thou make our enemies to see, and do thou show forth specters;—

verses.sa:
खडूरेऽधिचङ्क्रमां खर्विकां खर्ववासिनीम् ।
य उदारा अन्तर्हिता गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्च ये ।
सर्पा इतरजना रक्षांसि ॥
verses.rom:
khadure'dhichankramam kharvikam kharvavasinim |
ya udara antarhita gandharvapsarasashcha ye |
sarpa itarajana rakshamsi ||
verses.en: Her that strides upon the khaḍū́ra, mutilated, wearing what is mutilated (?); the specters that are concealed, and what Gandharvas-and-Apsarases [there are], serpents, other-folk, demons;—

verses.sa:
चतुर्दंष्ट्रां छ्यावदतः कुम्भमुष्कामसृङ्मुखान् ।
स्वभ्यसा ये चोद्भ्यसाः ॥
verses.rom:
chaturdamshtram chhyavadatah kumbhamushkamasrinmukhan |
svabhyasa ye chodbhyasah ||
verses.en: The four-tusked ones, the black-toothed, the pot-testicled, the blood-faced; they that are self-frighting and frighting.

verses.sa:
उद्वेपय त्वमर्बुदेऽमित्राणाममूः सिचः ।
जयंश्च जिष्णुश्चामित्रां जयतामिन्द्रमेदिनौ ॥
verses.rom:
udvepaya tvamarbude'mitranamamuh sichah |
jayamshcha jishnushchamitram jayatamindramedinau ||
verses.en: Do thou, O Arbudi, make to tremble yonder lines (síc) of our enemies; let both the conquering one and the conqueror, allied with Indra, conquer our enemies.

verses.sa:
प्रब्लीनो मृदितः शयां हतोऽमित्रो न्यर्बुदे ।
अग्निजिह्वा धूमशिखा जयन्तीर्यन्तु सेनया ॥
verses.rom:
prablino mriditah shayam hato'mitro nyarbude |
agnijihva dhumashikha jayantiryantu senaya ||
verses.en: Let our enemy lie squelched, crushed, slain, O Nyarbudi; let tongues of fire, tufts of smoke, go conquering with the army.

verses.sa:
तयार्बुदे प्रणुत्तानामिन्द्रो हन्तु वरंवरम् ।
अमित्राणां शचीपतिर्मामीषां मोचि कश्चन ॥
verses.rom:
tayarbude pranuttanamindro hantu varamvaram |
amitranam shachipatirmamisham mochi kashchana ||
verses.en: Of our enemies, pushed forth by it, O Arbudi, let Indra, lord of might (çácīpáti), slay each best man (vára); let no one soever of them be freed.

verses.sa:
उत्कसन्तु हृदयान्यूर्ध्वः प्राण उदीषतु ।
शौष्कास्यमनु वर्तताममित्रान् मोत मित्रिणः ॥
verses.rom:
utkasantu hridayanyurdhvah prana udishatu |
shaushkasyamanu vartatamamitran mota mitrinah ||
verses.en: Let their hearts burst open (ut-kas), their breath pass up aloft; let dryness of mouth follow after our enemies, and not those who are friendly.

verses.sa:
ये च धीरा ये चाधीराः पराञ्चो बधिराश्च ये ।
तमसा ये च तूपरा अथो बस्ताभिवासिनः ।
सर्वांस्तामर्बुदे त्वममित्रेभ्यो दृशे कुरूदारांश्च प्र दर्शय ॥
verses.rom:
ye cha dhira ye chadhirah parancho badhirashcha ye |
tamasa ye cha tupara atho bastabhivasinah |
sarvamstamarbude tvamamitrebhyo drishe kurudaramshcha pra darshaya ||
verses.en: Both they who are wise (dhī́ra) and they who are unwise, those going away and they who are deaf, they of darkness arid they who are

verses.sa:
अर्बुदिश्च त्रिषन्धिश्चामित्रान् नो वि विध्यताम् ।
यथैषामिन्द्र वृत्रहन् हनाम शचीपतेऽमित्राणां सहस्रशः ॥
verses.rom:
arbudishcha trishandhishchamitran no vi vidhyatam |
yathaishamindra vritrahan hanama shachipate'mitranam sahasrashah ||
verses.en: Let both Arbudi and Trishandhi pierce through our enemies, in order that, O Indra, Vṛitra-slayer, lord of might, we may slay of them, of our enemies, by thousands.

verses.sa:
वनस्पतीन् वानस्पत्यान् ओषधीरुत वीरुधः ।
गन्धर्वाप्सरसः सर्पान् देवान् पुण्यजनान् पितॄन् ।
सर्वांस्तामर्बुदे त्वममित्रेभ्यो दृशे कुरूदारांश्च प्र दर्शय ॥
verses.rom:
vanaspatin vanaspatyan oshadhiruta virudhah |
gandharvapsarasah sarpan devan punyajanan pitrin |
sarvamstamarbude tvamamitrebhyo drishe kurudaramshcha pra darshaya ||
verses.en: The forest-trees, them of the forest-trees, herbs and plants, Gandharvas-and-Apsarases, serpents, gods, pure-folk (puṇyajaná). Fathers—all those, O Arbudi, do thou make our enemies to see, and do thou show forth specters.

verses.sa:
ईशां वो मरुतो देव आदित्यो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ।
ईशां व इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च धाता मित्रः प्रजापतिः ।
ईशां व ऋषयश्चक्रुरमित्रेषु समीक्षयन् रदिते अर्बुदे तव ॥
verses.rom:
isham vo maruto deva adityo brahmanaspatih |
isham va indrashchagnishcha dhata mitrah prajapatih |
isham va rishayashchakruramitreshu samikshayan radite arbude tava ||
verses.en: Mastery over you have the Maruts [gained], the heavenly Āditya, Brahmaṇaspati; mastery over you have both Indra and Agni, Dhātar, Mitra, Prajāpati; mastery over you have the seers gained (kṛ)—exhibiting among the enemies—in case of thy bite, O Arbudi.

verses.sa:
तेषां सर्वेषामीशाना उत्तिष्ठत सं नह्यध्वम् ।
मित्रा देवजना यूयमिमं संग्रामं संजित्य यथालोकं वि तिष्ठध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
tesham sarveshamishana uttishthata sam nahyadhvam |
mitra devajana yuyamimam samgramam samjitya yathalokam vi tishthadhvam ||
verses.en: Masters (ī́çāna) of them all, stand ye up, equip yourselves, ye friends, god-folks; having wholly conquered in this conflict, scatter ye to your several worlds.

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठत सं नह्यध्वमुदाराः केतुभिः सह ।
सर्पा इतरजना रक्षांस्यमित्रान् अनु धावत ॥
verses.rom:
uttishthata sam nahyadhvamudarah ketubhih saha |
sarpa itarajana rakshamsyamitran anu dhavata ||
verses.en: Stand ye up, equip yourselves, ye specters, together with ensigns; ye serpents, other-folks, demons, run after our enemies.

verses.sa:
ईशां वो वेद राज्यं त्रिषन्धे अरुणैः केतुभिः सह ।
ये अन्तरिक्षे ये दिवि पृथिव्यां ये च मानवाः ।
त्रिषन्धेस्ते चेतसि दुर्णामान उपासताम् ॥
verses.rom:
isham vo veda rajyam trishandhe arunaih ketubhih saha |
ye antarikshe ye divi prithivyam ye cha manavah |
trishandheste chetasi durnamana upasatam ||
verses.en: Your mastery I know, [your] kingdom, O Trishandhi, together with red ensigns; what in the atmosphere, what in the sky, and what men (mānavá) [are] on the earth, let those ill-named ones sit (? upa-ās) in the mind (cétas) of Trishandhi.

verses.sa:
अयोमुखाः सूचीमुखा अथो विकङ्कतीमुखाः ।
क्रव्यादो वातरंहस आ सजन्त्वमित्रान् वज्रेण त्रिषन्धिना ॥
verses.rom:
ayomukhah suchimukha atho vikankatimukhah |
kravyado vataramhasa a sajantvamitran vajrena trishandhina ||
verses.en: Iron-(áyas-)mouthed, needle-mouthed, likewise thorn-tree-(vikan̄kaṭī-)mouthed, let the flesh-eaters, of wind-swiftness, fasten on our enemies with the three-jointed (tríṣandhi) thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
अन्तर्धेहि जातवेद आदित्य कुणपं बहु ।
त्रिषन्धेरियं सेना सुहितास्तु मे वशे ॥
verses.rom:
antardhehi jataveda aditya kunapam bahu |
trishandheriyam sena suhitastu me vashe ||
verses.en: O Jatavedas, Aditya, put thou between much human flesh; let this army of Trishandhi be well-placed in my control.

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठ त्वं देवजनार्बुदे सेनया सह ।
अयं बलिर्व आहुतस्त्रिषन्धेराहुतिः प्रिया ॥
verses.rom:
uttishtha tvam devajanarbude senaya saha |
ayam balirva ahutastrishandherahutih priya ||
verses.en: Stand thou up, O god-folk, O Arbudi, with the army; this tribute is offered (ā-hu) to you pl.; the offering [is] dear to Trishandhi.

verses.sa:
शितिपदी सं द्यतु शरव्येयं चतुष्पदी ।
कृत्येऽमित्रेभ्यो भव त्रिषन्धेः सह सेनया ॥
verses.rom:
shitipadi sam dyatu sharavyeyam chatushpadi |
kritye'mitrebhyo bhava trishandheh saha senaya ||
verses.en: Let the white-footed one tie together, this shaft (çaravyā̀), four-footed; O witchcraft, be thou for our enemies, together with the army of Trishandhi.

verses.sa:
धूमाक्षी सं पततु कृधुकर्णी च क्रोशतु ।
त्रिषन्धेः सेनया जिते अरुणाः सन्तु केतवः ॥
verses.rom:
dhumakshi sam patatu kridhukarni cha kroshatu |
trishandheh senaya jite arunah santu ketavah ||
verses.en: Let the smoke-eyed (f.) one fall together, and the crop-eared one (f.) yell; it being conquered by the army of Trishandhi, let the ensigns be red.

verses.sa:
अवायन्तां पक्षिणो ये वयांस्यन्तरिक्षे दिवि ये चरन्ति ।
श्वापदो मक्षिकाः सं रभन्तामामादो गृध्राः कुणपे रदन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
avayantam pakshino ye vayamsyantarikshe divi ye charanti |
shvapado makshikah sam rabhantamamado gridhrah kunape radantam ||
verses.en: Let the winged ones descend, the birds, they that go about in the atmosphere, in the sky; let the wild beasts, the flies, take hold together; let the raw-flesh-eating vultures scratch at the human carrion.

verses.sa:
यामिन्द्रेण संधां समधत्था ब्रह्मणा च बृहस्पते ।
तयाहमिन्द्रसंधया सर्वान् देवान् इह हुव इतो जयत मामुतः ॥
verses.rom:
yamindrena samdham samadhattha brahmana cha brihaspate |
tayahamindrasamdhaya sarvan devan iha huva ito jayata mamutah ||
verses.en: The agreement (saṁdhā) which thou hast agreed on with Indra and with the bráhman, O Brihaspati, by that Indra-agreement do I call hither all the gods: conquer ye on this side, not on that!

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिराङ्गिरस ऋषयो ब्रह्मसंशिताः ।
असुरक्षयणं वधं त्रिषन्धिं दिव्याश्रयन् ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatirangirasa rishayo brahmasamshitah |
asurakshayanam vadham trishandhim divyashrayan ||
verses.en: Brihaspati of the An̄giras race, the seers sharpened by the bráhman, set up (ā-çri) in the sky the Asura-destroying weapon, Trishandhi.

verses.sa:
येनासौ गुप्त आदित्य उभाविन्द्रश्च तिष्ठतः ।
त्रिषन्धिं देवा अभजन्तौजसे च बलाय च ॥
verses.rom:
yenasau gupta aditya ubhavindrashcha tishthatah |
trishandhim deva abhajantaujase cha balaya cha ||
verses.en: By whom yonder sun, and Indra, both stand protected—Trishandhi the gods shared, in order to both force and strength.

verses.sa:
सर्वांल्लोकान्त्समजयन् देवा आहुत्यानया ।
बृहस्पतिराङ्गिरसो वज्रं यमसिञ्चतासुरक्षयणं वधम् ॥
verses.rom:
sarvamllokantsamajayan deva ahutyanaya |
brihaspatirangiraso vajram yamasinchatasurakshayanam vadham ||
verses.en: All worlds did the gods completely conquer by means of that offering (ā́huti)—the thunderbolt which Brihaspati of the An̄giras race poured, an Asura-destroying weapon.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिराङ्गिरसो वज्रं यमसिञ्चतासुरक्षयणं वधम् ।
तेनाहममूं सेनां नि लिम्पामि बृहस्पतेऽमित्रान् हन्म्योजसा ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspatirangiraso vajram yamasinchatasurakshayanam vadham |
tenahamamum senam ni limpami brihaspate'mitran hanmyojasa ||
verses.en: The thunderbolt which Brihaspati of the An̄giras race poured, an Asura-destroying weapon—therewith do I blot out (ni-lip) yon army, O Brihaspati; I slay the enemies with force.

verses.sa:
सर्वे देवा अत्यायन्ति ये अश्नन्ति वषट्कृतम् ।
इमां जुषध्वमाहुतिमितो जयत मामुतः ॥
verses.rom:
sarve deva atyayanti ye ashnanti vashatkritam |
imam jushadhvamahutimito jayata mamutah ||
verses.en: All the gods come over hither, who partake of [the offering] made with váṣat; enjoy ye this offering; conquer ye on this side, not on that!

verses.sa:
सर्वे देवा अत्यायन्तु त्रिषन्धेराहुतिः प्रिया ।
संधां महतीं रक्षत ययाग्रे असुरा जिताः ॥
verses.rom:
sarve deva atyayantu trishandherahutih priya |
samdham mahatim rakshata yayagre asura jitah ||
verses.en: Let all the gods come over hither; the offering [is] dear to Trishandhi; defend ye the great agreement by which in the beginning the Asuras were conquered.

verses.sa:
वायुरमित्राणामिष्वग्राण्याञ्चतु ।
इन्द्र एषां बाहून् प्रति भनक्तु मा शकन् प्रतिधामिषुम् ।
आदित्य एषामस्त्रं वि नाशयतु चन्द्रमा युतामगतस्य पन्थाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vayuramitranamishvagranyanchatu |
indra esham bahun prati bhanaktu ma shakan pratidhamishum |
aditya eshamastram vi nashayatu chandrama yutamagatasya pantham ||
verses.en: Let Vāyu bend up the arrow-points of the enemies; let Indra break back their arms; let them not be able to set the arrow; let Āditya make their missile weapon (astrá) disappear; let the moon put (yu) them on the track of what is not gone.

verses.sa:
यदि प्रेयुर्देवपुरा ब्रह्म वर्माणि चक्रिरे ।
तनूपानं परिपाणं कृण्वाना यदुपोचिरे सर्वं तदरसं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
yadi preyurdevapura brahma varmani chakrire |
tanupanam paripanam krinvana yadupochire sarvam tadarasam kridhi ||
verses.en: If they have gone forward to the gods' strongholds, have made the bráhman their defenses; if (? yát) they have encouraged (? upa-vac) themselves, making a body-protection, a complete protection—all that do thou make sapless.

verses.sa:
क्रव्यादानुवर्तयन् मृत्युना च पुरोहितम् ।
त्रिषन्धे प्रेहि सेनया जयामित्रान् प्र पद्यस्व ॥
verses.rom:
kravyadanuvartayan mrityuna cha purohitam |
trishandhe prehi senaya jayamitran pra padyasva ||
verses.en: Causing to follow the puróhita with the flesh-eating [fire] and with death, O Trishandhi, go forth with the army; conquer the enemies; go forward.

verses.sa:
त्रिषन्धे तमसा त्वममित्रान् परि वारय ।
पृषदाज्यप्रणुत्तानां मामीषां मोचि कश्चन ॥
verses.rom:
trishandhe tamasa tvamamitran pari varaya |
prishadajyapranuttanam mamisham mochi kashchana ||
verses.en: O Trishandhi, do thou envelop our enemies with darkness; of them yonder, thrust forth by the speckled butter, let none soever be freed.

verses.sa:
शितिपदी सं पतत्वमित्राणाममूः सिचः ।
मुह्यन्त्वद्यामूः सेना अमित्राणां न्यर्बुदे ॥
verses.rom:
shitipadi sam patatvamitranamamuh sichah |
muhyantvadyamuh sena amitranam nyarbude ||
verses.en: Let the white-footed one (f.) fall upon (? sam-pat) yonder lines of our enemies; let yonder armies of our enemies be confounded today, O Nyarbudi.

verses.sa:
मूढा अमित्रा न्यर्बुदे जह्येषां वरंवरम् ।
अनया जहि सेनया ॥
verses.rom:
mudha amitra nyarbude jahyesham varamvaram |
anaya jahi senaya ||
verses.en: Confounded [be] our enemies, O Nyarbudi; slay thou of them each best man (vára); slay [them] with this army.

verses.sa:
यश्च कवची यश्चाकवचोऽमित्रो यश्चाज्मनि ।
ज्यापाशैः कवचपाशैरज्मनाभिहतः शयाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yashcha kavachi yashchakavacho'mitro yashchajmani |
jyapashaih kavachapashairajmanabhihatah shayam ||
verses.en: Whoever is mailed, and who without mail, and what enemy is in march (? ájman); by bowstring-fetters, by mail-fetters, smitten by the march let him lie.

verses.sa:
ये वर्मिणो येऽवर्माणो अमित्रा ये च वर्मिणः ।
सर्वांस्तामर्बुदे हतां छ्वानोऽदन्तु भूम्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye varmino ye'varmano amitra ye cha varminah |
sarvamstamarbude hatam chhvano'dantu bhumyam ||
verses.en: Who have defenses, who have no defenses, and the enemies who have defenses—all those, O Arbudi, being slain, let dogs eat on the ground.

verses.sa:
ये रथिनो ये अरथा असादा ये च सादिनः ।
सर्वान् अदन्तु तान् हतान् गृध्राः श्येनाः पतत्रिणः ॥
verses.rom:
ye rathino ye aratha asada ye cha sadinah |
sarvan adantu tan hatan gridhrah shyenah patatrinah ||
verses.en: Who have chariots, who have no chariots, those without seats and they who have seats (sādá)—all those, being slain, let vultures, falcons, birds (patatrín) eat.

verses.sa:
सहस्रकुणपा शेतामामित्री सेना समरे वधानाम् ।
विविद्धा ककजाकृता ॥
verses.rom:
sahasrakunapa shetamamitri sena samare vadhanam |
vividdha kakajakrita ||
verses.en: Let the army of our enemies lie with thousand corpses (-kúṇapa) in the conflict of weapons, pierced through, cut to pieces (?).

verses.sa:
मर्माविधं रोरुवतं सुपर्णैरदन्तु दुश्चितं मृदितं शयानम् ।
य इमां प्रतीचीमाहुतिममित्रो नो युयुत्सति ॥
verses.rom:
marmavidham roruvatam suparnairadantu dushchitam mriditam shayanam |
ya imam pratichimahutimamitro no yuyutsati ||
verses.en: Let the eagles (suparṇá) eat him, pierced to the vitals, crying loudly, lying crushed, the evil-minded one—what enemy of ours wishes to fight against this opposing offering.

verses.sa:
यां देवा अनुतिष्ठन्ति यस्या नास्ति विराधनम् ।
तयेन्द्रो हन्तु वृत्रहा वज्रेण त्रिषन्धिना ॥
verses.rom:
yam deva anutishthanti yasya nasti viradhanam |
tayendro hantu vritraha vajrena trishandhina ||
verses.en: [The offering] which the gods follow (anu-sthā), of which there is no failure—with that let Indra, Vṛitra-slayer, slay, with the three-jointed thunderbolt.
